title: Emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi Surfaces in hybrid Al/InAs heterostructures
summary: We investigate the microwave electrodynamics of a proximitized two-dimensional electron gas in hybrid superconductor/semiconductor heterostructures. Using lumped-element resonators with inductor wires oriented relative to an in-plane magnetic field, we directly probe the superfluid stiffness via the kinetic inductance. As the field increases, the resonance frequency exhibits a non-monotonic and strongly anisotropic evolution that cannot be explained by orbital pair breaking alone. We show that this behavior is consistent with the emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, which selectively suppress the supercurrent response depending on the direction of the magnetic field. Microscopic calculations of the stiffness tensor capture the observed anisotropy driven by the interplay of Zeeman and orbital Fulde-Ferrell effects. Our results establish microwave stiffness measurements as a sensitive probe of anisotropic gapless superconductivity in hybrid systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微波电动力学测量研究了混合超导体/半导体异质结构中邻近化的二维电子气的超流体刚度。利用集总元件谐振器，在平面内磁场下直接探测动能电感，发现共振频率呈现非单调且强烈各向异性的演化。这一现象无法仅用轨道对破坏解释，而是与Bogoliubov费米面的出现一致，后者会选择性地抑制不同方向的超流响应。微观刚度张量计算捕获了塞曼效应与轨道Fulde-Ferrell效应相互作用驱动的各向异性。该工作确立了微波刚度测量作为探测混合系统中各向异性无能隙超导电性的灵敏手段。
AI.motivation: 理解混合超导体/半导体异质结构中邻近化二维电子气的超导电性机制，特别是磁场下超流体刚度的各向异性行为，以及探索轨道对破坏之外的可能物理机制。
AI.method: 使用集总元件谐振器，电感线相对平面内磁场定向放置，通过动能电感直接探测超流体刚度；结合微观刚度张量计算，分析塞曼效应与轨道Fulde-Ferrell效应的相互作用。
AI.result: 发现磁场增加时共振频率呈现非单调且强各向异性演化，该行为与Bogoliubov费米面的出现一致，其选择性抑制依赖磁场方向的超流响应；理论计算重现了所观测的各向异性。
AI.conclusion: 微波刚度测量是探测混合系统中各向异性无能隙超导电性的灵敏探针，Bogoliubov费米面在该系统中的出现可通过磁场方向依赖的超流响应加以验证。

title: Determination of the properties of a superconducting single crystal FeSe using an EPR spectroscopy
summary: Using an EPR spectrometer, the properties of single-crystal FeSe were studied in a magnetic field up to 6000 Oe at temperatures from 3.5 K to 8 K in the superconducting state and at temperatures above 8K and up to 25K in the normal state. It was shown that by measuring non-resonant spectrometer signals in zero and weak magnetic fields up to 30 Oe, it is possible to determine critical temperature Tc, the superconducting transition width, and the value of the first critical magnetic field Hc1 in FeSe single-crystal. Resonant EPR signals are observed in fields at 1400 Oe and 3400 Oe, which corresponds to the paramagnetism of doubly ionized iron atoms (Fe2+) in the FeSe crystal. Non-resonant EPR signals in a magnetic field up to 6000 Oe at temperatures from 3.5K to 8K are a nonlinear function of the field, and correspond to the superconducting mixed state of the FeSe, but at temperatures above 8K (up to 25K) they are field independent.

AI.tldr: 本文利用EPR谱仪研究了FeSe单晶在超导态（3.5-8K）和正常态（8-25K）下、磁场高达6000 Oe时的性质。通过测量零场和弱磁场（≤30 Oe）下的非共振谱仪信号，可确定超导转变温度Tc、转变宽度和第一临界磁场Hc1。在1400 Oe和3400 Oe观测到共振EPR信号，对应Fe²⁺离子的顺磁性；超导混合态中非共振信号为磁场的非线性函数，而正常态中与磁场无关。
AI.motivation: 研究FeSe单晶在超导态和正常态下的磁性和EPR特性，利用EPR谱仪这一非传统手段来表征超导参数（Tc、超导转变宽度、Hc1），并探测晶体中Fe²⁺离子的顺磁共振信号，从而深入了解FeSe超导体的电子结构和磁性质。
AI.method: 使用EPR（电子顺磁共振）谱仪，在磁场高达6000 Oe、温度范围3.5K至25K的条件下对单晶FeSe进行测量。通过区分共振和非共振信号：共振信号用于分析Fe²⁺顺磁中心，非共振信号在零场和弱磁场（≤30 Oe）下用于确定超导参数（Tc、转变宽度、Hc1），在更高磁场下用于区分超导混合态（非线性）与正常态（场无关）行为。
AI.result: 成功通过EPR谱仪的非共振信号确定了FeSe单晶的超导转变温度Tc、超导转变宽度和第一临界磁场Hc1。在1400 Oe和3400 Oe处观测到两个共振EPR信号，归属于Fe²⁺离子的顺磁性。超导混合态（3.5-8K）中非共振EPR信号随磁场呈非线性变化，而正常态（8-25K）中信号与磁场无关。
AI.conclusion: EPR谱仪可以作为表征FeSe超导体超导参数（Tc、转变宽度、Hc1）的有效工具，同时能探测Fe²⁺顺磁中心的共振信号。非共振信号的磁场依赖性可清晰区分超导混合态与正常态，为理解FeSe超导体的磁性质提供了新的实验手段。

title: Origin of the superconductor-insulator transition in disordered two-dimensional films
summary: Theory predicts the superconductor-to-insulator transition (SIT) to emerge from the competition between Anderson localization, which tends to localize single-particle wavefunctions, and superconductivity, which establishes long-range correlations in the superconducting order parameter. In two-dimensional (2D) superconducting films, the transition temperature $T_\text{c}$ at which resistance vanishes, $R_\Box(T_\text{BKT}){=}0$, is set by the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) mechanism and satisfies $T_\text{BKT}< T_{c0}$, where $T_{c0}$ is the mean-field transition temperature. In weakly disordered samples $T_\text{BKT}\lesssim T_{c0}$, whereas increasing disorder drives $T_\text{BKT}\ll T_{c0}$ near the SIT. Whether the finite-temperature transition retains its BKT character throughout this crossover remains an open question. Here, we investigate the evolution of both sheet resistance $R_\Box(T)$ and superfluid stiffness $J_s(T)$ over a wide range of disorder strength $W$. We establish that even near the SIT, the finite-temperature transition from the superconducting to the resistive state remains of BKT type. However, as disorder approaches the critical value, the zero temperature superfluid phase stiffness, $J_s(0)$, is found to vanish rapidly while $T_{c0}$ remains finite, which we attribute to quantum phase fluctuations as the drive for the zero-temperature transition. Three decades after its experimental discovery by Haviland, Liu, and Goldman, our measurements clarify the origin of the SIT in 2D films.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究二维超导薄膜在宽范围无序强度下的超导-绝缘体转变（SIT），发现即使在接近SIT时有限温度转变仍保持BKT类型，但零温超流刚度快速消失，表明量子相位涨落是驱动零温转变的关键因素，解决了该领域三十年来悬而未决的问题。
AI.motivation: 理论上预测SIT源于Anderson局域化与超导性之间的竞争，但在弱无序到强无序（接近SIT）的整个转变过程中，有限温度转变是否始终保持BKT特征仍是一个悬而未决的问题，需要实验验证。
AI.method: 在宽范围的无序强度W范围内，系统测量二维超导薄膜的方块电阻R□(T)和超流刚度Js(T)，追踪两者随无序强度的演变规律，并分析转变温度与零温超流刚度的行为。
AI.result: 即使在接近SIT时，有限温度超导态到电阻态的转变仍保持BKT类型；但随无序接近临界值时，零温超流刚度Js(0)迅速消失，而平均场转变温度Tc0保持有限，表明量子相位涨落驱动了零温转变。
AI.conclusion: 实验明确阐明了二维薄膜中SIT的起源：有限温度转变始终保持BKT特征，而零温转变由量子相位涨落驱动，为Haviland、Liu和Goldman三十年前发现的SIT提供了清晰的物理解释。

title: Emergent magnetic pseudogap from phase fluctuations and hierarchy of scales in two-dimensional superconductors
summary: Preformed pairs and phase fluctuations are believed to play a vital role in predicting the charge pseudogap in the normal state of two-dimensional superconductors. In this work, we extend this idea and further identify the emergent magnetic pseudogap from pure phase fluctuations without invoking any competing order. We examine the NMR relaxation rate $1/T_1T$ by evaluating the bubble contribution and leading-order vertex correction within perturbation theory. It is found that the magnetic pseudogap, manifesting as a smooth suppression of $1/T_1T$ in the normal state, is characterized by a temperature scale $T_\text{mPG}$ distinct from the superconducting gap $Δ_\text{SC}$ and transition temperature $T_c$. The onset scales of both charge and magnetic pseudogap are dominated by the competition of BKT correlation length $ξ(T)$ and BCS coherence length $ξ_\text{BCS}$. Moreover, the vertex correction is shown to be irrelevant for $d$-wave pairing, while it becomes prominent in $s$-wave systems and drives a coherent enhancement of $1/T_1T$ at lower temperatures just above $T_c$. We attribute this normal-state enhancement of $1/T_1T$ to the diverging coherence peak at the $s$-wave superconducting gap edge, which shares the same spirit as the celebrated Hebel-Slichter peak in the BCS theory. Analogous to the coherent Hebel-Slichter peak, regularization by Fermi-liquid-like scatterings is important and is characterized by a scattering length $\ell$. The normal-state coherent enhancement of $1/T_1T$ is hence described by the competition of $ξ(T)$ and $\ell$, through which the coherence scale $T_\text{coh}$ is determined. As a result, the complete evolution of $1/T_1T$ is understood quantitatively in a unified picture as the interplay among hierarchy of scales $ξ(T)$, $ξ_\text{BCS}$ and $\ell$.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了预形成电子对与相位涨落的概念，从纯相位涨落出发（不引入竞争序）识别出二维超导体正常态中涌现的磁赝隙。通过微扰论计算NMR弛豫率1/T1T的泡利贡献与领头阶顶角修正，发现磁赝隙表现为1/T1T的平滑抑制，其温度尺度TmPG区别于超导能隙ΔSC和转变温度Tc。赝隙（电荷与磁）起始尺度由BKT关联长度ξ(T)与BCS相干长度ξBCS的竞争主导。顶角修正对d波配对可忽略，但对s波显著，并在Tc以上低温区驱动1/T1T的相干增强，归因于s波能隙边缘发散的相干峰（类比BCS理论中的Hebel-Slichter峰），需费米液体散射（散射长度ℓ）正则化。因此1/T1T的完整演化由ξ(T)、ξBCS与ℓ的层级竞争统一描述。
AI.motivation: 预形成电子对和相位涨落被认为在预测二维超导体正常态电荷赝隙中起关键作用。作者希望将这一思想扩展，探究纯相位涨落是否能不借助任何竞争序而自然地产生磁赝隙，从而为理解高温超导体正常态反常性质提供统一理论框架。
AI.method: 采用微扰理论：计算NMR弛豫率1/T1T的泡利（bubble）贡献和领头阶顶角修正；考察d波与s波两种配对对称性；引入BKT关联长度ξ(T)、BCS相干长度ξBCS以及散射长度ℓ三个长度尺度，构建层级竞争的统一描述框架。
AI.result: (1) 纯相位涨落即可产生磁赝隙，表现为正常态1/T1T的平滑抑制，其特征温度尺度TmPG独立于ΔSC和Tc；(2) 电荷与磁赝隙的起始均由ξ(T)与ξBCS竞争主导；(3) 顶角修正对d波可忽略，对s波显著，在Tc以上驱动1/T1T相干增强，源于s波能隙边缘的发散相干峰（类Hebel-Slichter峰）；(4) 该增强需费米液体散射正则化，由ξ(T)与ℓ竞争决定相干尺度Tcoh。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一个统一图像：1/T1T的完整演化可由ξ(T)、ξBCS和ℓ三个尺度间的相互作用定量理解。该工作不仅将赝隙概念从电荷通道推广到磁通道，还揭示了s波系统中正常态类Hebel-Slichter相干增强的存在，为理解二维超导体的正常态性质提供了统一的层级尺度框架。

title: Cascading Through the Hierarchy: Regularizer-Induced Feature Detection as Phase Transitions in Deep Linear Neural Networks
summary: A scientific theory of deep learning, comprising learning dynamics and statistical properties of learned models, is rapidly gaining attention. One of the corner stones of this development are analytically solvable toy models, allowing for the fully tractable analysis of the learning dynamics. Here we analytically investigate such a toy model using the regularization strength as a tunable external parameter - akin to external fields in statistical physics. In previous studies, (i) an onset of learning transition was predicted analytically and (ii) it was phenomenologically/numerically established that tuning the regularization strength can result in a cascade of phase transitions. The number of those transitions was linked to the geometry of the loss landscape determined by the model complexity. Setting up a rigorous framework underpinning the previous numerical observations, our investigation reveals a precise connection between those cascades of phase transitions, learnable features and the underlying geometry. We provide analytic predictions of these phase transitions as well as tractable order parameters related to learned features. At the level of the minimal model, we connect this macroscopic perspective (that can be condensed into an effective description) to the microscopic perspective in terms of the geometry of the loss landscape characterized by the Hessian spectrum. Thus, the presented model provides a platform to explore and sharpen advances made in the scientific theory of deep learning rooted in statistical physics concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文从统计物理角度分析了一个可解析求解的深度学习玩具模型，以正则化强度为外部可调参数，严格建立了先前数值观察到的相变级联、可学习特征与损失景观几何之间的精确联系，并提供了相变的解析预测及与学习特征相关的可追踪序参量。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的科学理论（包括学习动力学和统计性质）正受到广泛关注，解析可解的玩具模型是这一发展的基石。先前研究已从解析上预测了学习转变的起始，并从现象学/数值上证实调节正则化强度可引发一连串相变，相变数量与模型复杂度决定的损失景观几何相关。然而缺少一个严格框架来支撑这些数值观察。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个严格的分析框架，通过将正则化强度视为类似统计物理中的外部场，在最小模型层面分析了深度学习的相变级联。该框架将宏观视角（可凝聚为有效描述）与微观视角（由Hessian谱表征的损失景观几何）联系起来，推导出相变的解析预测以及刻画学习特征的序参量。
AI.result: 作者揭示了相变级联、可学习特征与底层几何之间的精确联系，给出了这些相变的解析预测，并得到了与学习特征相关的可追踪序参量。在最小模型层面成功连接了宏观有效描述与基于Hessian谱的微观几何视角。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为探索和深化基于统计物理概念的深度学习科学理论提供了一个平台，架起了宏观相变现象与微观损失景观几何之间的桥梁。

title: Theory of spin-wave transport in ferromagnet-superconductor heterostructures: Negative refraction, perfect imaging and temperature-controlled spin-wave optics
summary: We investigate spin-wave transport in ferromagnetic insulator-superconductor (FMI-SC) heterostructures and develop a general theoretical framework for spin-wave optics in these hybrid systems. We demonstrate that Meissner screening by the superconductor gives rise to a range of unconventional wave phenomena, including negative phase- and group-velocity refraction, and reflection and refraction laws that differ fundamentally from their optical counterparts. Within this framework, we derive the spin-wave Fresnel equations governing reflection and transmission at FMI-SC interfaces and show that the scattering properties exhibit a pronounced temperature dependence, enabling tunable spin-wave mirrors and refractive elements. Most strikingly, we find that superconducting screening can produce nearly straight isofrequency contours, far flatter than the kinked, intrinsically curved contours attainable in conventional dipolar spin-wave systems. We show that these straight contours enable functionalities such as perfect spin-wave imaging, efficient waveguiding, and interferometric elements, such as phase shifters and beam splitters, with unconventional properties. Our results establish FMI-SC heterostructures as a versatile platform for temperature-tunable spin-wave optics and interferometric magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了铁磁绝缘体-超导体（FMI-SC）异质结构中的自旋波输运，建立了混合系统中自旋波光学的通用理论框架，发现超导体的Meissner屏蔽效应可产生负相速度和负群速度折射、与光学规律根本不同的反射折射定律，以及几乎笔直的等频轮廓，从而实现完美的自旋波成像、高效波导和干涉元件等功能。
AI.motivation: 传统偶极自旋波系统中等频轮廓是固有弯曲（kinked）的，限制了自旋波光学器件的功能。作者希望探索超导体引入的新自由度，以实现更平坦的等频轮廓和前所未有的自旋波光学现象。
AI.method: 针对FMI-SC异质结构建立通用理论框架，推导自旋波Fresnel方程来描述FMI-SC界面的反射和透射，分析Meissner屏蔽对自旋波传播的影响。
AI.result: 证明了Meissner屏蔽可产生负相/群速度折射、非常规反射折射定律、强温度依赖的散射特性，以及比传统系统平坦得多的近似直线等频轮廓，支持完美自旋波成像、高效波导、相位偏移器和分束器等干涉元件。
AI.conclusion: FMI-SC异质结构可作为温度可调的自旋波光学和干涉型磁子器件的多功能平台。

title: Predictive beam-lattice reduction for higher-order topological modes in a 2D SSH phononic crystal
summary: We develop a mechanically faithful reduced model for a two-dimensional topological phononic crystal composed of rigid square masses connected by slender elastic ligaments. Exploiting Euler Bernoulli beam theory, we derive a Hermitian 12 degree of freedom dynamical matrix that retains in-plane translations, rotations, and ligament eccentricity. This reduction captures effects that are absent from scalar mass spring SSH models while remaining computationally much more tractable and more easily interpretable than full finite element simulations. Dimerizing the ligament widths produces a mechanical 2D SSH lattice with a full band gap and a quantized bulk polarization. The sign of the dimerization controls the transition from trivial to non trivial phases, while ligament eccentricity provides an additional purely geometric mechanism for changing the topology. Ribbon and finite cell calculations predict in gap edge and corner modes, quantified by localization measures and confirmed by finite element simulations. Measurements on 3D printed samples show an evanescent response in the trivial structure and enhanced boundary/corner response in the non trivial structure within the predicted gap. The results provide a validated route for designing topological elastic metamaterials using a continuum informed discrete model rather than either idealized mass spring networks or brute force numerical optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个力学上保真的降阶模型，用于二维拓扑声子晶体（刚性方形质量块通过细长弹性韧带连接）。基于欧拉-伯努利梁理论，推导出包含12个自由度的厄米动力学矩阵，保留了面内平移、旋转和韧带偏心效应。该模型比标量质量-弹簧SSH模型更准确（能捕捉旋转和偏心效应），又比有限元模拟更高效易解释。研究发现：韧带宽度二聚化产生2D机械SSH晶格，具有完全带隙和量子化体极化；二聚化符号控制平庸/非平庸相变，韧带偏心提供额外的几何拓扑调控机制。带状和有限元计算预测了带内边界和角模式，有限元模拟和3D打印实验均验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 传统的质量-弹簧SSH模型过于理想化，忽略了旋转自由度和韧带偏心等关键物理效应，而全有限元模拟计算成本高且难以解释。作者希望开发一个介于两者之间的中间路线——既保留连续介质力学保真度又保持计算可处理性的降阶模型，用于设计拓扑弹性超材料。
AI.method: 基于欧拉-伯努利梁理论，推导包含12个自由度（面内平移、旋转、韧带偏心）的厄米动力学矩阵，用于描述刚性质量块与弹性韧带组成的晶格。通过二聚化韧带宽度构建2D SSH晶格，分析二聚化符号和韧带偏心对拓扑相的影响；使用带状计算、有限元模拟和3D打印实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 模型成功捕获了标量质量-弹簧模型中缺失的旋转和偏心效应。二聚化符号控制平庸/非平庸相变，韧带偏心可作为额外的纯几何拓扑调控机制。理论预测的带内边界/角模式被有限元模拟和3D打印实验证实：平庸结构表现出衰减响应，非平庸结构表现出增强的边界/角响应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一条经过验证的拓扑弹性超材料设计路径：使用连续介质信息的离散模型而非理想化质量-弹簧网络或暴力数值优化。这一方法兼顾了物理保真度与计算效率，为拓扑弹性材料设计提供了实用的中间路线。

title: Sublattice-resolved coherent phonon dynamics in charge density waves
summary: Phonons govern fundamental material properties and play a central role in various electronic phase transitions. Coherent driving of specific phonon modes enables on-demand phase control, motivating sublattice-resolved identification of real-space phonon motions. Yet experimentally resolving these motions remains challenging, limiting precise phonon-based control. Here, we introduce a dynamical protocol to track element-resolved phonon dynamics in the charge density wave material EuTe4, in which the dominant Te-sublattice charge order is accompanied by a previously unreported Eu-sublattice component. We leverage the elemental selectivity of time-resolved resonant X-ray scattering to reveal three coherent phonon modes with distinct sublattice character, thereby disentangling Eu- and Te-dominated lattice dynamics, in good agreement with theoretical calculations of the phonon eigenvectors. This time-domain approach, which surpasses the energy-resolution limits of conventional frequency-domain inelastic scattering, provides a broadly applicable framework for decomposing coherent phonons in multi-element materials, which is crucial for the targeted control of phases of matter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动力学协议，利用时间分辨共振X射线散射的元素选择性，在电荷密度波材料EuTe4中追踪元素分辨的声子动力学，成功区分了Eu和Te主导的晶格振动模式，并揭示了一个此前未被报道的Eu亚晶格电荷序成分。
AI.motivation: 相干驱动特定声子模式可以实现按需相控，这需要亚晶格分辨地识别实空间声子运动。然而，实验上解析这些运动具有挑战性，限制了基于声子的精确控制。
AI.method: 利用时间分辨共振X射线散射的元素选择性，在EuTe4电荷密度波材料中追踪元素分辨的声子动力学，结合声子本征矢量的理论计算进行验证。
AI.result: 揭示了三个具有不同亚晶格特征的相干声子模式，成功区分了Eu和Te主导的晶格动力学，与理论计算的声子本征矢量高度吻合，并发现了此前未报道的Eu亚晶格电荷序成分。
AI.conclusion: 该时域方法超越了传统频域非弹性散射的能量分辨率极限，为多元素材料中相干声子的分解提供了广泛适用的框架，对目标性物相控制至关重要。

title: Composite Fields and Tree Expansions: A Unified Framework for Renormalized Vertex Decompositions
summary: One-particle irreducible vertices encode renormalized interactions in quantum field theories, but their practical treatment remains challenging due to their high dimensionality and nontrivial dependence on external variables such as momenta or frequencies. We develop a functional framework that algebraically reorganizes the diagrammatic content of the vertex functions into more efficient building blocks and reveals several established vertex decompositions, such as parquet, single-boson exchange, asymptotic classes and symmetric estimators, as different realizations of a common functional structure. Based on Legendre transforms of the effective action of composite fields, the formalism shows that different vertex representations arise from different choices of composite degrees of freedom. We demonstrate that in our framework higher-order vertices can be systematically obtained via tree expansions, thereby extending the aforementioned decompositions beyond the four-point level. Because our findings are independent of any specific physical setting, the framework applies broadly to quantum field theories in condensed matter physics, particle physics, and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个功能框架，通过复合场有效作用量的Legendre变换，将量子场论中单粒子不可约顶点的图解内容代数性地重组为更高效的构建模块，统一了parquet、单玻色子交换、渐近类和对称估计量等已建立的顶点分解方案，并将这些分解推广到四点以上级别。
AI.motivation: 单粒子不可约顶点编码了量子场论中的重整化相互作用，但其实际处理因高维性和对外部变量（如动量或频率）的非平凡依赖而极具挑战性。现有的各种顶点分解方法（如parquet、单玻色子交换等）虽然各自有效，但缺乏统一的数学基础来揭示它们之间的内在联系，也无法系统扩展到更高阶顶点。
AI.method: 基于复合场有效作用量的Legendre变换，将不同顶点表示视为不同复合自由度选择的体现。通过代数性地重组顶点的图解内容为更高效的构建模块，并利用树展开（tree expansions）系统性地获得高阶顶点，从而将已有分解方案拓展到四点以上水平。
AI.result: 揭示了parquet、单玻色子交换、渐近类和对称估计量等顶点分解方案都是同一功能结构的不同实现，证明了不同顶点表示源于复合自由度的不同选择，并成功地将这些分解推广到四点以上级别。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不依赖于任何特定物理设置，因此可广泛应用于凝聚态物理、粒子物理及其他领域的量子场论，为顶点的高效处理提供了统一的理论基础。

title: Competing Energetics Govern Gas Permeation in Polymer of Intrinsic Microporosity (PIM) Membranes
summary: Polymer membranes, particularly polymers of intrinsic microporosity (PIMs), hold great promise for gas separation applications. However, the long-dominant solution-diffusion model, which treats the membrane as a nonporous homogeneous medium, does not resolve how gas-solid atomic interactions govern molecular transport in intrinsic micropores, limiting rational bottom-up membrane design. In this work, we employ non-equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the permeation of various gases (He, H2, CH4, N2, O2, and CO2) through PIM-1 as a representative PIM membrane across a range of temperatures. By analyzing the scaling of gas permeability with molecular mass, we identify a temperature-induced transition in the dominant transport mechanism. We demonstrate that this transition is governed by the competition between gas-wall interaction potential energy and thermal kinetic energy: weak interactions or elevated temperatures facilitate Knudsen-type ballistic transport, whereas strong interactions and lower temperatures favor adsorption-mediated surface diffusion. Furthermore, molecular trajectory analysis at the membrane interface reveals two distinct entry pathways: direct entry through pore openings and surface-diffusion-assisted entry. The surface-diffusion-assisted pathway greatly promotes the entry of strongly interacting gases into the membrane, contributing to higher overall permeability, albeit this enhancement diminishes with increasing temperature. These findings offer a mechanistic picture of gas permeation in PIM-1 and explain the dependence of gas permeation on both gas type and temperature. More broadly, they highlight the importance of adopting a pore-flow perspective to understand gas transport in microporous polymer membranes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过非平衡分子动力学模拟，系统探究了气体（He、H2、CH4、N2、O2、CO2）在PIM-1微孔聚合物膜中的渗透机制，发现温度可诱导气体传输机制从Knudsen弹道输运向吸附介导的表面扩散转变，并揭示了两种不同的气体进入膜内的路径。
AI.motivation: 传统的溶液扩散模型将膜视为无孔均质介质，无法解释气体与固体原子间相互作用如何主导本征微孔中的分子传输，这限制了聚合物膜的自下而上理性设计。
AI.method: 采用非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）模拟，以PIM-1为代表性PIM膜，在不同温度下模拟六种气体（He、H2、CH4、N2、O2、CO2）的渗透过程；通过分析气体渗透率与分子质量的标度关系来识别传输机制转变，并利用分子轨迹分析界面处的进入路径。
AI.result: 发现温度诱导主导传输机制转变，其受气体-孔壁相互作用势能与热动能之间的竞争调控：弱相互作用或高温利于Knudsen弹道传输，强相互作用和低温利于吸附介导的表面扩散。界面轨迹分析揭示两种进入路径：直接经孔口进入和表面扩散辅助进入，后者显著促进强相互作用气体的进入，但该效应随温度升高而减弱。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为PIM-1中气体渗透提供了机理层面的完整图景，解释了气体渗透对气体种类和温度的依赖关系，并强调应从孔隙流动（pore-flow）视角理解微孔聚合物膜中的气体传输。

title: Onset of the transitional flux-avalanche regime in bulk NbTi controlled by the thermal boundary conductance
summary: Thermomagnetic avalanches in type-II superconductors occur in two qualitatively different regimes, electromagnetically controlled in thin films and thermally limited in bulk samples, distinguished by the sign of the temperature derivative of the threshold field $H_\text{th}(T)$. The two regimes are separated by a critical thermal boundary conductance $h_c$, and a non-monotonic $H_\text{th}(T)$ has been predicted in the transitional region where the interface conductance $h$ approaches $h_c$. We approach this region in a bulk NbTi disk by raising the interface coupling above the pure-nonadecane baseline with a silver-filled interface layer. Whereas the pure interface gives a monotonically decreasing $H_\text{th}(T)$, the silver-filled interface produces a non-monotonic dependence not previously realized in a bulk superconductor: a temperature interval of positive slope, $dH_\text{th}/dT > 0$, terminating in a maximum at $T^* \approx 6.1$--$6.4$~K. The effect is reproduced for two independent silver-filled compositions; in a third, with the highest loading, the low-temperature decrease is absent altogether and $H_\text{th}(T)$ is flat up to the same $T^*$, the evolution expected for stronger coupling. The position of the maximum is set by the intrinsic properties of NbTi, independent of the silver content. The onset of the positive-slope interval coincides in temperature with a change of the avalanche morphology from narrow channeled fingers to broad fronts. The reversal of the sign of $dH_\text{th}/dT$ is a direct experimental signature of the onset of the transitional regime, in which heat removal during the instability becomes dynamically relevant.

AI.tldr: 本文在体块NbTi超导盘中，通过引入银填充界面层提高界面热导，首次实验观察到体块超导体中热磁雪崩阈值场H_th(T)的非单调温度依赖，标志着从电磁控制向热受限的过渡区域出现。
AI.motivation: 理解II类超导体中热磁雪崩的两种不同机制（薄膜中的电磁控制与体块中的热受限），以及两者之间过渡区域的理论预测——非单调的H_th(T)——至今缺乏实验验证。
AI.method: 在体块NbTi超导盘上，以纯正十九烷为基准界面，通过添加银填充界面层来提高界面耦合热导h，使其接近临界界面热导h_c，从而进入过渡区域，测量不同银含量下阈值场H_th(T)的温度依赖关系，并结合雪崩形貌观察。
AI.result: 纯界面给出单调下降的H_th(T)；银填充界面产生非单调依赖，出现dH_th/dT>0的正斜率区间并在T*≈6.1-6.4K处达到最大值。该效应在两种银填充组分中重现，第三种高填充组分中低温下降消失、H_th(T)平坦至同一T*。T*由NbTi本征性质决定，与银含量无关。正斜率区间的起始温度与雪崩形貌从窄通道指状到宽前缘的转变相吻合。
AI.conclusion: dH_th/dT符号的反转是过渡区域开始的直接实验证据，表明在不稳定性过程中热移除变得动力学相关。该工作首次在体块超导体中实验实现了过渡区域，验证了理论预测。

title: Statistical stability of random potentials to thermal and quantum activation
summary: In numerous physical, chemical, and biological systems the dynamics can be reduced to the motion of state variables in a complex potential landscape. In case the manifold is known, the motion and response of the embedded object can be described deterministically up to stochastic effects usually associated with a noise. In contrast, if the manifold is unknown, the static and dynamic response of the state variable may be used as a spectroscopic tool to characterize the potential landscape. Inspired by a seminal work of L.\ Embon and co-workers, [Sci.\ Rep.\ \textbf{5}, 7598 (2015)] we investigate the statistical properties of potential minima, in particular, their stability to thermal and quantum activation. For Gaussian random manifolds, we derive an algebraic expression to evaluate the statistical probability of the potential character (value, slope, curvature, ...). With this tool, we compute the expectation value for the rate of thermal and quantum activation and link these findings to the principal characteristics of the Gaussian potential, i.e., its Green's function. This link provides the opportunity to access information on the potential's Green's function by studying the activation behavior of an object in this manifold.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高斯随机势能面上势能极小值的统计性质，特别是其对热激活和量子激活的稳定性。作者推导出代数表达式来评估势能特征（值、斜率、曲率等）的统计概率，并利用该工具计算热激活和量子激活速率的期望值，将其与高斯势能的格林函数联系起来，从而通过激活行为来获取势能面的信息。
AI.motivation: 在许多物理、化学和生物系统中，动力学可简化为状态变量在复杂势能面上的运动。当流形已知时，运动可确定性描述；但当流形未知时，需要利用状态变量的静态和动态响应作为光谱工具来表征势能面。受Embon等人工作的启发，作者希望从统计角度理解势能极小值的性质及其稳定性。
AI.method: 对于高斯随机流形，作者推导出代数表达式来评估势能特征（值、斜率、曲率等）的统计概率。利用此工具，计算热激活和量子激活速率的期望值，并将其与高斯势能的主要特征——格林函数——建立联系。
AI.result: 作者成功推导出高斯随机势能面上势能特征的统计概率代数表达式，并计算出热激活和量子激活速率的期望值，建立了激活行为与势能格林函数之间的直接联系。
AI.conclusion: 通过研究对象在流形中的激活行为，可以获取势能面格林函数的信息，这为表征未知势能面提供了一种新的光谱学方法。

title: Effectiveness of Some 0 dB Cryogenic Microwave Attenuators as Thermal Heatsinks
summary: Coaxial cables are widely used in radiofrequency and microwave cryogenic setups for condensed matter and quantum experiments. Since the inner conductor of coaxes is often in good thermal contact with the sample to be measured, it is desirable to know the phononic heat channeled by the inner conductor. Although cryogenic attenuators are widely used to thermalize the inner conductor of coaxes, to our knowledge, quantitative information is not available. We present data on the effectiveness of three commercially available 0 dB attenuators as thermal heatsinks. In particular, we measured the temperature of the inner pin of several 0 dB attenuators under a heat load. This information will aid in designing and carefully controlling the thermal environment of samples in high-frequency experiments mounted in dilution refrigerators and on nuclear demagnetization stages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了商用0 dB衰减器作为同轴电缆内导体热沉的有效性，通过测量热负载下0 dB衰减器内针的温度，为稀释制冷机和核退磁平台上高频实验的样品热环境设计提供了定量参考数据。
AI.motivation: 同轴电缆广泛应用于低温射频和微波实验中，其内导体常与待测样品良好热接触，因此需要了解内导体传导的声子热流。虽然低温衰减器常被用于热化同轴电缆内导体，但缺乏定量数据来指导设计。
AI.method: 对三种商用0 dB衰减器作为热沉的有效性进行实验测量，在施加热负载的情况下测量各0 dB衰减器内针的温度。
AI.result: 提供了三种商用0 dB衰减器在热负载下作为热沉的定量温度数据，展示了它们作为热沉的有效性差异。
AI.conclusion: 这些定量信息将有助于在稀释制冷机和核退磁平台上设计和精确控制高频实验中样品的温度环境。

title: Adjoint shape optimization of oscillatory rarefied gas flows
summary: A fast-converging and asymptotic-preserving adjoint shape optimization method is proposed for drag reduction of multiscale gas flows in vibrating micro-electro-mechanical systems. The convergence of the Boltzmann kinetic equation is accelerated by macroscopic synthetic equations, whose constitutive relations integrate continuum-limit terms and high-order kinetic corrections to faithfully characterize spatiotemporal rarefaction effects. As such, this method maintains near-continuum limit consistency while retaining high kinetic accuracy in rarefied flow regimes. Fourier stability analysis performed in an infinite domain demonstrates that the present method yields a spectral radius below 0.5, indicating that the numerical deviation from the converged solution is halved per iteration. Numerical simulations are conducted on an oscillating cylinder and a comb-shaped resonator. The results verify the high accuracy of the derived adjoint sensitivities and the excellent drag reduction performance of the proposed method across various Knudsen and Strouhal numbers. Compared with conventional kinetic iteration methods, the present method produces convergent primal and adjoint solutions within dozens of iterations and features asymptotic preserving behavior, permitting spatial cell sizes far larger than the molecular mean free path. This facilitates efficient design of vibrating micro-electro-mechanical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种快速收敛且渐近保持的伴随形状优化方法，用于振动微机电系统（MEMS）中多尺度气体流动的减阻设计。该方法通过宏观合成方程加速玻尔兹曼动力学方程的收敛，在保持近连续介质极限一致性的同时，保留稀薄流领域的动力学精度。
AI.motivation: 振动微机电系统中的气体流动涉及多尺度效应，传统动力学迭代方法收敛缓慢，且对空间网格尺寸存在严格限制（需小于分子平均自由程），难以高效进行形状优化设计以降低阻力。
AI.method: 提出一种渐近保持的伴随形状优化方法。其核心是采用宏观合成方程加速玻尔兹曼动力学方程的收敛，合成方程的本构关系融合了连续介质极限项和高阶动力学修正项，以准确刻画时空稀薄效应。通过傅里叶稳定性分析验证了方法的收敛性能。
AI.result: 傅里叶稳定性分析表明该方法的谱半径低于0.5，即每次迭代将数值偏差减半。在振荡圆柱和梳齿形谐振器上的数值模拟验证了伴随灵敏度的准确性和减阻性能。与传统动力学迭代方法相比，该方法在数十次迭代内即可获得收敛的正向和伴随解，并允许空间网格尺寸远大于分子平均自由程。
AI.conclusion: 该渐近保持的伴随形状优化方法在收敛速度、精度和计算效率方面均优于传统方法，为振动微机电系统的高效减阻设计提供了有效的工具。

title: Nonreciprocity reversal of magnetoacoustic attenuation in NiFe alloy thin films
summary: Nonreciprocity, the asymmetry of transport, underlies technologies from the diode to the microwave isolator. In a ferromagnet, a surface acoustic wave generates an elliptical effective field with propagation-locked handedness, breaking the reciprocity of its propagation. Despite decades of study on this phenomenon, a method for controlling the sign of the nonreciprocity has remained elusive. Here we observe a sign reversal in Ni$_x$Fe$_{100-x}$ films. A 0.8 at.% change across Permalloy's zero-magnetostriction composition, where the magnetoelastic coefficient $b$ changes sign, reverses the handedness of the elliptical effective field and thereby the nonreciprocity, from 78.6% to -61.8%. Angle-dependent measurements and spin-wave-ellipticity modelling show that reversing the sign of $b$ reverses the handedness of the elliptically polarized effective field. Aided by cubic frequency scaling, we resolve the sign of $b$ down to -0.05 MPa in a 10-nm film, establishing nonreciprocity as a nanoscale probe of magnetoelastic coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在NiₓFe₁₀₀₋ₓ薄膜中观察到非互易性符号反转现象。通过在Permalloy零磁致伸缩组分附近仅0.8 at.%的成分变化，使磁弹系数b改变符号，从而反转椭圆有效场的旋向，进而将非互易性从78.6%反转为-61.8%。该工作确立了非互易性可作为纳米尺度探测磁弹耦合的手段，能够分辨10纳米薄膜中低至-0.05 MPa的磁弹系数b的符号。
AI.motivation: 尽管铁磁体中表面声波产生的传播锁定手性椭圆有效场导致的非互易性现象已被研究数十年，但控制非互易性符号的方法一直难以实现，这是该领域长期未解的问题。
AI.method: 通过改变NiₓFe₁₀₀₋ₓ薄膜中x的浓度（跨越Permalloy零磁致伸缩组分），调控磁弹系数b的符号；结合角度依赖测量和自旋波椭圆度建模，分析椭圆有效场旋向与非互易性的关系，并利用频率三次方标度关系进行符号分辨。
AI.result: 0.8 at.%的成分变化使非互易性从78.6%反转为-61.8%；角度依赖测量和自旋波椭圆度建模证实b符号反转逆转了椭圆极化有效场的旋向；在10纳米薄膜中成功分辨出低至-0.05 MPa的b符号。
AI.conclusion: 磁弹系数b的符号是控制非互易性方向的关键参数，通过成分调控可实现非互易性的可控符号反转；非互易性可作为高灵敏度的纳米尺度磁弹耦合探针，为磁声学器件和自旋电子学的应用提供新途径。

title: Excitonic Magnetism in Ruthenium Pyrochlores
summary: Strong spin-orbit coupling in $d^4$ systems is expected to stabilize a nonmagnetic $J=0$ singlet ground state, yet many ruthenium pyrochlores exhibit robust long-range magnetic order. Motivated by this apparent contradiction, we develop a microscopic theory of Van Vleck excitonic magnetism on the pyrochlore lattice. Starting from a multi-orbital Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling, we derive the effective superexchange interactions within the low-energy singlet--triplet manifold of Ru$^{4+}$ ions. We analyze the resulting excitonic Hamiltonian using both the spectrum of triplon excitations and a variational treatment of the condensed phase. We identify the instability of the nonmagnetic singlet state toward triplon condensation and determine the resulting magnetic phase diagram as a function of the microscopic hopping parameters. The phase diagram reproduces the magnetic orders known from conventional pyrochlore models while also predicting an additional magnetic phase unique to the singlet--triplet description. Finally, we apply the theory to the pyrochlore ruthenates, with particular emphasis on Nd$_2$Ru$_2$O$_7$, and show that it lies in close proximity to the excitonic quantum critical point. Our results establish a microscopic framework for understanding excitonic magnetism in pyrochlore ruthenates and their magnetic excitation spectrum, providing direct connections to spectroscopic probes, including Raman scattering.

AI.tldr: 本文针对$d^4$体系（钌焦绿石）中自旋轨道耦合预期稳定非磁性$J=0$单重态、但实验却观察到长程磁序的矛盾，发展了一套基于Van Vleck激子磁性的微观理论。从多轨道Hubbard模型出发推导有效超交换相互作用，通过triplon激发谱和凝聚相变分处理分析激子哈密顿量，绘制了磁相图，并用于解释Nd$_2$Ru$_2$O$_7$等焦绿石钌酸盐的磁性行为。
AI.motivation: 强自旋轨道耦合的$d^4$体系理论上应稳定非磁性的$J=0$单重态基态，但许多钌焦绿石却表现出稳健的长程磁序，这一明显矛盾表明现有理论框架不足以描述此类体系，亟需建立能解释该现象的微观理论。
AI.method: 从含自旋轨道耦合的多轨道Hubbard模型出发，在Ru$^{4+}$离子的低能单重态-三重态流形内推导有效超交换相互作用；利用triplon激发谱和凝聚相变分处理两种手段分析激子哈密顿量，识别非磁单重态向triplon凝聚的不稳定性，并确定随微观跳跃参数变化的磁相图。
AI.result: 获得的相图重现了传统焦绿石模型已知的磁有序，同时预测了一个单重态-三重态描述所独有的新磁性相。将该理论应用于焦绿石钌酸盐（重点为Nd$_2$Ru$_2$O$_7$），发现该材料位于激子量子临界点附近。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了理解焦绿石钌酸盐中激子磁性的微观框架，为磁激发谱提供了理论预测，并与拉曼散射等光谱探测手段建立了直接联系，解决了$d^4$体系中$J=0$单重态与实验观测磁序之间的表观矛盾。

title: Ground-State Energy Estimation of HeH$^{+}$, ArH$^{+}$, and H$_2$O via Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization
summary:
Accurate ground-state energies are essential for understanding molecular structure, chemical bonding, and reaction energetics in quantum chemistry. In this work, we investigate the ground-state properties of the molecular systems HeH$^+$, ArH$^+$, and H$_2$O using Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD), a hybrid quantum-classical framework designed for near-term quantum devices. Unlike variational approaches such as VQE, which require deep parameterized circuits and repeated expectation-value measurements, SQD reconstructs a low-energy determinant subspace directly from measured bitstrings.
  For the present calculations, bitstrings were generated on IBM quantum hardware using shallow local unitary cluster Jastrow (LUCJ) circuits whose parameters were constructed from the $t_1$ and $t_2$ amplitudes of coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD) calculations based on restricted Hartree--Fock (RHF) references. From these samples, we compute ground-state potential-energy curves of HeH$^+$, ArH$^+$, and H$_2$O with the 6-31G and cc-pVDZ basis sets. For all three systems, the SQD results obtained with the cc-pVDZ basis closely follow the corresponding same-basis CCSD energies and reproduce the equilibrium-region trends of the potential-energy curves. HeH$^+$ and ArH$^+$ were chosen as simple yet astrophysically important molecular-ion benchmarks, while H$_2$O was included as a representative polyatomic molecule to assess the applicability of SQD beyond diatomic ionic systems. At the adopted equilibrium geometries, the deviations from the same-active-space CASCI references are 0.00, 2.51, and 6.34 mHa for HeH$^+$, ArH$^+$, and H$_2$O, respectively.
  These results demonstrate the feasibility of hardware-assisted SQD for the present benchmark systems and motivate further studies of its accuracy and computational scaling for larger molecular active spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法在IBM量子硬件上计算HeH⁺、ArH⁺和H₂O分子基态能量的可行性。利用浅层LUCJ电路生成位串样本，结合CCSD参数构建，所得结果在cc-pVDZ基组下与CCSD能量高度吻合，验证了SQD作为VQE替代方案在近期量子设备上的实用性。
AI.motivation: 量子化学中精确的基态能量对理解分子结构、化学键和反应能量至关重要。传统变分方法如VQE需要深层参数化电路和重复期望值测量，在近期含噪量子设备上难以扩展。SQD通过直接从测量的位串中重建低能量行列式子空间，避免了VQE的深度电路需求，是一种更适合近期量子硬件的混合量子-经典框架。
AI.method: 采用SQD混合量子-经典框架：在IBM量子硬件上使用浅层LUCJ电路生成位串样本，电路参数由基于RHF参考的CCSD计算得到的t₁和t₂振幅构建。从采样位串中重建低能量行列式子空间，进而计算基态势能曲线。基组选用6-31G和cc-pVDZ，系统涵盖HeH⁺、ArH⁺（天体物理相关分子离子）和H₂O（多原子分子）。
AI.result: 三个分子系统在cc-pVDZ基组下的SQD结果与同基组CCSD能量紧密吻合。在平衡几何构型下，与相同活性空间CASCI参考的偏差分别为：HeH⁺ 0.00 mHa、ArH⁺ 2.51 mHa、H₂O 6.34 mHa。SQD能正确再现平衡区域的势能曲线趋势。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了硬件辅助SQD方法在基准分子系统上的可行性，展示了其相比VQE在近期量子设备上的优势，并为进一步探索更大分子活性空间的SQD精度和计算扩展性提供了动力。

title: Distribution of the Radius of Gyration for an ISAW
summary: We aim at calculating an explicit expression for the finite-size probability distribution of the radius of gyration $R$ of an Interacting Self-Avoiding Walk (ISAW), as a function of chain length $N$ and monomer-monomer interaction energy $\varepsilon$. We first derive the explicit free energy expression for a non-interacting Self-Avoiding Walk, introducing a new natural scale variable $t = ρ^g$ expressed as a power of the density $ρ$. Then, thanks to a cumulant expansion approach introduced by Lhuillier, Victor and coworkers, we extend it to the interacting case, capturing both the coil-globule transition and finite-size corrections to scaling, including entropic and surface-energy contributions. The radius of gyration distribution determined by the new free energy expression is then compared, using Bayesian inference to estimate the model parameters, to results from extensive Monte Carlo simulations of three-dimensional ISAWs, showing excellent agreement except very close to the $Θ$-point, where finite chain lengths limit the accessible scaling regime. This validates our resulting free energy expression and allows us, as an application, to construct a phase diagram of the coil-globule transition.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了相互作用自避行走（ISAW）回转半径R的有限尺寸概率分布的显式表达式，通过引入新的自然尺度变量并结合累积量展开方法，捕捉了线圈-球状转变及有限尺寸修正，并通过贝叶斯推断与蒙特卡罗模拟结果进行验证，最终构建了相图。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在为ISAW的回转半径分布提供一个显式的解析表达式，以更好地理解聚合物链的线圈-球状转变和有限尺寸行为，弥补以往研究中缺乏精确解析解的不足。
AI.method: 首先推导非相互作用自避行走的显式自由能表达式，引入新的自然尺度变量t=ρ^g；然后利用Lhuillier、Victor等人提出的累积量展开方法将其扩展到相互作用情形，捕捉线圈-球状转变和有限尺寸修正；最后使用贝叶斯推断估计模型参数，并与三维ISAW的蒙特卡罗模拟结果进行对比验证。
AI.result: 得到的回转半径分布与蒙特卡罗模拟结果在绝大多数情况下高度一致，仅在接近Θ点时由于有限链长限制了可达的标度区间而出现偏差。该自由能表达式得到验证，并成功构建了线圈-球状转变的相图。
AI.conclusion: 该显式自由能表达式有效描述了ISAW的回转半径分布，为理解聚合物线圈-球状转变和有限尺寸效应提供了可靠的理论框架，其应用包括构建相图等。

title: Anderson Orthogonality as Measurement Backaction in Coupled Quantum Dots
summary: Measurement perturbs a quantum system by coupling it to external degrees of freedom, but detector backaction depends on the physical mechanism of measurement itself. In solid-state devices, detectors driven far from equilibrium to enable faster measurements produce backaction that can often be understood as classical noise. However, a strong measurement can also induce backaction from quantum many-body correlations in the detector that are intrinsic to the measurement, even without shot noise. Here, we probe this near-equilibrium backaction through the effect of a quantum-dot charge sensor on tunnelling between a second quantum dot and its reservoirs. The measurement realizes the Anderson Orthogonality Catastrophe (AOC): electrons in the detector leads reorganize in response to an abrupt change in local scattering potential, suppressing resonant tunnelling while enabling inelastic processes that exchange energy with the detector. Changing the detector energy level tunes the AOC backaction from negligible to dominant in the tunnelling dynamics. More broadly, these results establish detector-induced many-body correlations as a controllable influence on quantum dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量子点电荷传感器对第二个量子点隧穿过程的影响，实验验证了近平衡态下探测器反作用的量子多体关联本质，即安德森正交性灾难(AOC)。通过调节探测器能级，可将AOC反作用从可忽略调至主导隧穿动力学，确立探测器诱导的多体关联作为量子动力学的可控影响。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为强测量（远离平衡态）的探测器反作用可理解为经典噪声，但近平衡态下强测量引发的量子多体关联反作用（如AOC）尚未被充分研究。作者希望探明这种内在的、不依赖散粒噪声的量子反作用机制。
AI.method: 实验上使用量子点电荷传感器探测第二个量子点与其库之间的隧穿。测量过程实现了AOC效应：探测器引线中的电子响应于局域散射势的突变而重组，抑制共振隧穿，同时启动物理能量交换的非弹性过程。通过调节探测器能级来调控AOC反作用的强度。
AI.result: 实验证明随着探测器能级的改变，AOC反作用从可忽略过渡到主导隧穿动力学。揭示了由探测器诱导的多体关联即使在无散粒噪声的近平衡条件下也能显著影响量子系统动力学。
AI.conclusion: 探测器诱导的多体关联（AOC）是一种可控且可调的量子反作用机制，不同于经典噪声，它为量子动力学提供了新的调控手段，对固态量子器件中的测量物理具有重要意义。

title: Extracting the full conductivity tensor in a rectangular sample
summary: Electrical transport measurements reveal that many 2D materials exhibit anisotropic conductivity. However, current methodologies for rectangular geometries can only extract a partial conductivity tensor or are difficult to execute experimentally. Here, we propose a simple experimental procedure to extract the full conductivity tensor (or the resistivity tensor by inversion) including the principal axes angle. Our procedure is developed by using a conformal mapping approach to obtain an analytical expression for the potential with a point source and drain on the perimeter. Our solution agrees very well with numerical simulations using COMSOL and the known limiting case where the principal axes angle vanishes. Finite source/drains can be modeled using superposition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单实验方法，通过共形映射得到解析表达式，从矩形几何的2D材料中提取完整的电导率张量（包括主轴角度），解决了现有方法只能提取部分张量或难以实验操作的问题。
AI.motivation: 许多2D材料表现出各向异性电导率，但现有的矩形几何测量方法只能提取部分电导率张量，或实验执行困难，无法获取完整的张量信息（包括主轴角度）。
AI.method: 采用共形映射方法，推导点源和漏位于矩形周界时的电势解析表达式，通过该表达式从测量数据中提取完整的电导率张量（或通过求逆得到电阻率张量）及主轴角度。有限尺寸的源/漏可通过叠加原理建模，并用COMSOL数值模拟验证。
AI.result: 解析解与COMSOL数值模拟结果高度吻合，且在主轴角度为零的已知极限情况下也能正确退化到已有结果，验证了方法的正确性和可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种简单且易于实验操作的方法，能够从矩形几何的2D材料中提取完整的电导率/电阻率张量及其主轴角度，为各向异性2D材料的输运表征提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Suppression of orbital ordering and emergence of a glassy magnetic state in a high-entropy spinel vanadate
summary: High-entropy oxides provide a unique platform for exploring the interplay between configurational disorder and correlated electronic states. We report on structural, thermodynamic, and magnetic properties of the high-entropy spinel vanadate (Li$_{0.2}$Mg$_{0.2}$Mn$_{0.2}$Co$_{0.2}$Zn$_{0.2}$)V$_2$O$_4$, in which orbital-active V ions occupy the pyrochlore sublattice. X-ray diffraction measurements reveal that the cubic spinel structure is preserved at temperatures down to 5 K without any detectable symmetry lowering. Unlike conventional spinel vanadates exhibiting a symmetry-lowering structural transition driven by orbital ordering, the compound that we study exhibits a suppression of long-range orbital ordering in the high-entropy state. Magnetic susceptibility measurements show glassy magnetic freezing at temperatures below $\sim$20 K, while specific-heat measurements reveal no anomaly associated with long-range ordering down to 3 K. Frequency-dependent ac susceptibility reveals pronounced glassy dynamics. Analyses based on the Mydosh parameter, dynamic scaling law, and Vogel--Fulcher law suggest an intermediate dynamical regime between canonical spin-glass and cluster-glass behavior. Furthermore, Cole--Cole analyses reveal systematic deviations from a single Debye relaxation process, indicating the presence of heterogeneous magnetic relaxation dynamics near the freezing regime. Our results demonstrate that, in a frustrated spinel vanadate, high configurational entropy suppresses long-range orbital ordering and stabilizes a heterogeneous glassy magnetic state, highlighting the combined roles of geometrical frustration, orbital degrees of freedom, and configurational disorder in high-entropy magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高熵尖晶石钒酸盐(Li0.2Mg0.2Mn0.2Co0.2Zn0.2)V2O4，发现高构型熵抑制了长程轨道有序，同时稳定了异质玻璃态磁性，展示了几何阻挫、轨道自由度和构型无序在高温磁体中的共同作用。
AI.motivation: 高熵氧化物为探索构型无序与关联电子态之间的相互作用提供了独特平台。传统尖晶石钒酸盐会因轨道有序发生对称性破缺的结构相变，而高熵态下这一行为可能被抑制，值得深入探究。
AI.method: 通过X射线衍射（XRD）研究低温结构；磁化率测量表征磁性行为；比热测量检测长程有序异常；频率依赖的交流磁化率揭示玻璃态动力学；运用Mydosh参数、动态标度律、Vogel-Fulcher定律及Cole-Cole分析对弛豫动力学进行定量分析。
AI.result: 立方尖晶石结构在低至5 K时保持稳定，无对称性降低；长程轨道有序被抑制；玻璃态磁冻结发生在约20 K以下；比热在低至3 K无长程有序异常；动力学分析表明处于典型自旋玻璃与团簇玻璃之间的中间态；Cole-Cole分析揭示异质磁弛豫动力学。
AI.conclusion: 高构型熵在阻挫尖晶石钒酸盐中抑制了长程轨道有序，稳定了异质玻璃态磁状态，突出了几何阻挫、轨道自由度与构型无序在高熵磁体中的协同作用。

title: Interference between multiple photoionization pathways in chiral molecules: Converging continuum results in Gaussian bases
comment: APS REVTeX 4.2 format; 15 pages, 12 figures (including appendix). Preprint
summary: An accurate description of photoionization observables is a central challenge for theoretical models of molecular photoionization. Within standard electronic-structure approaches, the continuum states are represented by unoccupied Hartree-Fock orbitals expanded in Gaussian basis sets. Since these basis sets are optimized for bound states, computed observables may exhibit a noticeable basis-set dependence. Here, we augment these basis sets with diffuse functions and investigate the convergence of photoelectron circular dichroism (PECD), anisotropy parameters, and the forward backward ionization time delay in the multiphoton ionization of randomly oriented chiral molecules. All observables converge systematically with the number of added diffuse functions, resolving previously observed basis-set discrepancies and indicating that the augmented basis sets provide a more accurate representation of the intermediate continuum states. In particular, our fully ab initio calculations yield forward-backward time delays in qualitative agreement with recent measurements, for which previous theoretical descriptions relied on empirical modeling. Diffuse augmentation thus provides a computationally efficient and transferable route to converged Gaussian-basis calculations for molecular multiphoton photoionization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过在标准高斯基组中添加弥散函数，来提高分子多光子光电离过程中连续态的描述精度。研究表明，所有光电离观测量（包括光电子圆二色性、各向异性参数和前后向电离时间延迟）都随弥散函数数量的增加而系统收敛，解决了此前观测到的基组依赖性问题，且全从头算得到的前后向时间延迟与实验定性一致。
AI.motivation: 分子光电离观测量的精确描述是理论模型的核心挑战。标准电子结构方法中，连续态由高斯基组展开的非占据Hartree-Fock轨道表示，但这些基组是为束缚态优化的，导致计算观测量存在明显的基组依赖性偏差。
AI.method: 在标准高斯基组上添加弥散函数，系统增加弥散函数的数量，研究随机取向手性分子多光子电离中光电子圆二色性、各向异性参数和前后向电离时间延迟的收敛行为。
AI.result: 所有观测量随弥散函数数量的增加实现系统收敛，解决了此前观测到的基组差异问题。全从头算的前后向时间延迟与近期实验定性一致，而此前理论描述依赖经验建模。
AI.conclusion: 弥散函数增广是一种计算高效且可迁移的策略，能够实现分子多光子光电离高斯基组计算的收敛，为中间连续态提供更精确的表示。

title: Temperature-tunable spin-wave refraction using superconducting control elements
summary: Spin waves are promising signal carriers for microwave control at the micrometer scale. However, realizing low-damping, tunable control of spin-wave propagation remains a central challenge. Here we use magnetic shielding by superconducting control elements to tune the local spin-wave dispersion and realize temperature-controlled refraction of spin waves in a thin-film magnetic insulator. Using magnetic imaging based on spins in diamond, we characterize the refractive index and demonstrate both positive and negative refraction as well as wavefront shaping by the superconductors. The observed refraction is explained by a geometrical analysis of the superconductivity-induced modification of the hyperbolic spin-wave dispersion. Our results demonstrate that superconductors enable tunable spin-wave optical elements, opening new opportunities for microwave control in classical or quantum information devices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用超导控制元件的磁屏蔽效应，调节薄膜磁性绝缘体中自旋波的局域色散关系，实现了自旋波的正折射、负折射以及波前整形，并通过金刚石自旋磁成像进行表征。研究证明超导体可作为可调的自旋波光学元件，为微波控制开辟新途径。
AI.motivation: 自旋波是微波尺度控制的有前景的信号载体，但实现低损耗、可调的自旋波传播控制仍是核心挑战。现有方法难以同时实现低阻尼和可调的折射控制。
AI.method: 利用超导控制元件产生磁屏蔽效应，调节薄膜磁性绝缘体中局部自旋波色散；结合基于金刚石自旋的磁成像技术表征折射率；通过超导诱导的双曲型自旋波色散改变的几何分析来解释折射现象。
AI.result: 实验实现了自旋波的正折射和负折射，以及由超导体实现的波前整形；观测到的折射现象可通过超导引起的双曲型自旋波色散改变进行几何解释。
AI.conclusion: 超导体能够实现可调的自旋波光学元件，为经典或量子信息器件中的微波控制提供了新的机会。

title: Active movement of foraging sea turtles generates anomalous looping
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures (accompanied by 38 pages of supplementary information with 40 figures and 1 table)
summary: Animals inhabiting diverse environments by moving across different spatial scales, from insects to birds, marine predators, mammals and even humans, often display apparently random movement paths. Over the past decade, novel biologging technologies have recorded these patterns in increasing detail, generating a wealth of experimental data. A central challenge is to understand such complex patterns by constructing data-driven mathematical models. Many animal movements depart from Brownian motion, as described by correlated random walks, Lévy walks, or active particle dynamics. Yet, these movement models do not incorporate long-term non-Markovian memory extracted from experimental trajectories. Here, we construct a stochastic generalised Langevin equation from satellite tracking data for loggerhead sea turtles (Caretta caretta) foraging off the coast of West Africa. We find that these turtles exhibit active movement characterised by large-scale loops that are not explained by ocean currents or chirality. These loops maintain movement within a specific foraging region and, over intermediate timescales, generate superdiffusion similar to Lévy walks. We thus identify a loop-based form of active anomalous search related to foraging patterns observed across a wide range of animal species, which may inspire robotic search strategies and AI-based metaheuristic optimisation algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过卫星追踪数据为西非沿海觅食的蠵龟构建了随机广义朗之万方程，发现其运动呈现出大规模环状主动运动模式（而非洋流或手性所致），这种环状运动在中间时间尺度上产生类似莱维行走的超扩散行为，是一种基于环路的主动异常搜索策略，可能与多种动物的觅食模式相关，并可为机器人搜索和AI元启发式优化算法提供启发。
AI.motivation: 动物运动轨迹看似随机，但现有的运动模型（如相关随机行走、莱维行走、主动粒子动力学）均未纳入从实验轨迹中提取的长期非马尔可夫记忆特征，因此需要构建数据驱动的数学模型来更真实地理解复杂的动物运动模式。
AI.method: 从蠵龟的卫星追踪数据出发，构建了一个随机广义朗之万方程（stochastic generalised Langevin equation），利用该模型分析动物运动是否包含长期非马尔可夫记忆，并系统检验了洋流和手性（chirality）对运动模式的解释能力。
AI.result: 发现蠵龟表现出以大规模环状运动为特征的主动移动模式，这些环路不能由洋流或手性解释；环路将运动维持在特定觅食区域内，并在中间时间尺度上产生与莱维行走类似的超扩散现象。
AI.conclusion: 识别出一种基于环路的主动异常搜索形式，这种觅食模式在多种动物物种中普遍存在，可能启发机器人搜索策略和基于AI的元启发式优化算法的设计。

title: Cross-Geometry Transferability Assessment of Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: From Bulk Materials to Atomic Nanowires
summary: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable atomistic simulations at substantially lower computational cost than first-principles methods, but their reliability across structural geometries remains insufficiently understood. Here, we construct a density-functional-theory dataset of ZrO2 configurations spanning bulk, slab, particle, neck, and atomically thin wire environments motivated by an experimentally observed ZrO2 desintering process involving neck thinning and atomic wire formation. We first benchmark 26 pretrained MLIPs and observe pronounced geometry-dependent degradation in zero-shot predictions. Without any training, after only reference-energy alignment, the best zero-shot model (ORB-V3) reaches energy and force root-mean-square errors of 6 meV/atom and 197.3 meV/Å, respectively, with the largest force errors in neck and wire configurations. We then compare zero-shot inference, fine-tuning, and training from scratch strategies. Fine-tuning yields lower energy and force errors than training from scratch, while both require comparable wall-clock time. Geometry-specific fine-tuning improves in-domain accuracy but frequently produces negative transfer to other structural classes, whereas mixed-geometry fine-tuning reduces cross-geometry errors. Evaluations of elastic and vibrational properties, surface energies, and neck dynamics further show that rankings based on average energy and force errors do not universally predict property-level behavior. These results demonstrate that geometry-diverse target data and independent physical validations are necessary when adapting foundation MLIPs to low-coordination (ionic) nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了涵盖多种几何构型（体相、表面、颗粒、颈部和原子级细线）的ZrO2 DFT数据集，系统评估了26个预训练机器学习原子间势模型（MLIPs）在不同结构下的零样本预测能力。发现模型性能存在显著的几何依赖退化，通过能量对齐后最佳模型（ORB-V3）的力误差在颈部和细线结构中最大。研究比较了零样本推理、微调和从头训练三种策略，发现微调优于从头训练，但几何特定微调容易产生负迁移，而混合几何微调能降低跨几何误差。此外，基于平均能量和力误差的模型排名无法普遍预测弹性、振动、表面能等物理性质的准确性。
AI.motivation: 基础机器学习原子间势模型（MLIPs）能以远低于第一性原理方法的计算成本进行原子模拟，但其在不同结构几何构型下的可靠性尚未得到充分理解。实际实验中观察到的ZrO2去烧结过程涉及颈部变薄和原子线形成等复杂几何结构，这些低配位（离子性）纳米结构对MLIPs的泛化能力提出了严峻挑战，需要系统评估适应策略。
AI.method: 本研究首先构建了涵盖体相、表面、颗粒、颈部和原子级细线五种几何环境的ZrO2 DFT数据集。然后对26个预训练MLIPs进行零样本基准测试，评估参考能量对齐前后的表现。接着系统比较了三种适应策略：零样本推理、微调和从头训练，并进一步研究了几何特定微调与混合几何微调的差异。最后通过弹性性质、振动性质、表面能和颈部动力学等物理量进行独立验证。
AI.result: 研究发现所有MLIPs均存在显著的几何依赖性能退化。最佳零样本模型ORB-V3经参考能量对齐后达到6 meV/atom的能量误差和197.3 meV/Å的力误差，其中颈部和细线结构的力误差最大。微调策略在能量和力误差上均优于从头训练，且两者墙钟时间相当。几何特定微调虽能提高域内精度但常导致对其他结构类别的负迁移，而混合几何微调能减少跨几何误差。物理性质评估表明基于平均误差的模型排名不能普遍预测弹性、振动和表面能等性质的预测准确性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将基础MLIPs应用于低配位（离子性）纳米结构时，需要包含几何多样性的目标数据和独立的物理性质验证。单纯依赖平均能量和力误差的评估指标不足以全面反映模型在实际物理场景中的可靠性，几何特定的适应策略可能导致负迁移，而混合几何微调是更优的选择。

title: Prominent Intrinsic Orbital Hall Effect in the 135 Kagome Metal Family and Orbital Responses in the Loop-Current Phase
summary: The study of electronic orbital degrees of freedom, including the generation and control of orbital currents and orbital angular momentum, has emerged as a vibrant research field. Here, we study the orbital Hall effect (OHE), one of the key mechanisms for orbital current generation, in transition-metal kagome-lattice metals. We propose a large positive OHE in CsTi$_3$Bi$_5$ and negative OHEs in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ and CsCr$_3$Sb$_5$ models. Orbital-sector decomposition shows that the $\vert l^z_d \vert=2$ $d$-orbital channel gives a positive contribution, whereas the $\vert l^z \vert=1$ $d$- and $p$-orbital channels can give negative contributions. Control calculations suggest a persistent orbital-sector sign tendency near the actual filling, while strong $p$-$d$ hybridization modulates the quantitative balance and total OHE sign. Thus, the compound and filling dependence of the OHE reflects both the sign tendency of each orbital sector and the hybridization-controlled balance among them. Furthermore, we investigate the loop-current phase of CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ and show that it induces finite local atomic orbital angular momentum. We also show that loop-current-related symmetry lowering allows finite symmetric components of the orbital conductivity tensor. This study provides a basis for exploring orbital currents and local orbital-angular-momentum responses in strongly correlated kagome metals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了过渡金属kagome晶格金属中的轨道霍尔效应（OHE），发现CsTi₃Bi₅模型具有大的正OHE，而CsV₃Sb₅和CsCr₃Sb₅模型具有负OHE。通过轨道扇区分解揭示|ℓ_z|=2的d轨道通道贡献为正，而|ℓ_z|=1的d和p轨道通道贡献为负，p-d杂化调控了各扇区间的平衡与总OHE符号。此外，还研究了CsV₃Sb₅中的环流相，证明其可诱导有限的局域原子轨道角动量并降低对称性，从而允许轨道电导张量出现有限对称分量。
AI.motivation: 电子轨道自由度（包括轨道电流和轨道角动量的产生与控制）已成为活跃研究领域，作者希望理解强关联kagome金属中轨道电流的产生机制，特别是轨道霍尔效应在不同材料中的符号与大小差异及其微观来源。
AI.method: 采用轨道扇区分解方法，将轨道霍尔电导按不同|ℓ_z|通道（d轨道|ℓ_z|=2和|ℓ_z|=1通道以及p轨道|ℓ_z|=1通道）进行分解分析；通过控制计算检验近实际填充下轨道扇区的符号倾向；并对CsV₃Sb₅的环流相进行对称性分析，研究局域轨道角动量和轨道电导张量分量的影响。
AI.result: 发现CsTi₃Bi₅具有大的正OHE，CsV₃Sb₅和CsCr₃Sb₅具有负OHE；|ℓ_z|=2的d轨道通道贡献为正，|ℓ_z|=1的d和p轨道通道贡献为负；强p-d杂化调控各扇区间的定量平衡从而决定总OHE符号；环流相会诱导有限的局域原子轨道角动量，且对称性降低允许轨道电导张量出现有限对称分量。
AI.conclusion: 化合物的OHE符号和大小取决于各轨道扇区的固有符号倾向与p-d杂化调控的平衡关系；该研究为探索强关联kagome金属中的轨道电流和局域轨道角动量响应提供了基础。

title: Density-Functional Excited-State Gradients and Nonadiabatic Couplings on a Consumer GPU from a Contraction-DAG
summary: Nonadiabatic dynamics needs an excited-state gradient and an interstate nonadiabatic coupling matrix element (NACME) at every nuclear geometry, and a double-hybrid functional's accuracy has been unavailable for the coupling. We report the first analytic derivative NACME for a double-hybrid excited state---deferred in the original hh-TDA method and supplied for hybrids only by Yu \emph{et al.}---derived, with the hole-hole and particle-particle Tamm--Dancoff (\hhTDA/\ppTDA) gradients and NACMEs, as a single reverse-mode transpose of one contraction graph closed under a non-symmetric atomic-orbital-direct $J/K$ kernel. Its double-hybrid excitation energy lowers the vertical-excitation mean absolute deviation from bare-\hhTDA\ $0.86$ to $0.47$~eV and removes the $+0.53\!\rightarrow\!+0.05$~eV over-excitation bias, improving seven of ten states while over-correcting the ionic $ππ^*$ states---the expected perturbative-doubles failure, reported not trimmed. Every coupling is validated to $\sim\!10^{-4}$ against an independent \emph{literal many-electron wavefunction-overlap} oracle that shares no code path with the method, and is physically meaningful at the ammonia $n\!\rightarrow\!σ^*$ \emph{covalent} conical intersection, where the \hhTDA/\ppTDA manifolds recover the $F\!-\!2$ seam and adiabatic linear-response TDDFT gives $τ\!\equiv\!0$ by construction. Gradients, NACMEs, and the double-hybrid coupling all run device-resident and AO-direct through one shared Cholesky-decomposed $J/K$ engine within the 8\,GB of a consumer RTX~4060 (a profile-guided $\sim\!10^2\times$ launch collapse preserving double-precision bit-identity)---placing on a commodity desktop card a correlated excited-state derivative capability that has until now required datacenter hardware.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次为双杂化泛函激发态推导并实现了解析导数非绝热耦合矩阵元（NACME），基于hhTDA/ppTDA方法，通过非对称原子轨道直J/K核的单收缩图反向模式转置实现。双杂化激发能将垂直激发平均绝对偏差从0.86 eV降至0.47 eV，消除了过激发偏差，所有耦合通过与独立波函数重叠Oracle对照验证到~10⁻⁴精度，并在氨n→σ*共价锥形交叉点上有物理意义。所有计算均在消费级RTX 4060（8GB）上运行，实现了此前需数据中心硬件的能力。
AI.motivation: 非绝热动力学需要每个核构型下的激发态梯度和态间非绝热耦合矩阵元（NACME），但双杂化泛函的精度此前无法用于耦合项计算。原始hh-TDA方法中这一能力被延期，而Yu等人仅为杂化泛函提供了该功能。
AI.method: 作者推导了hhTDA/ppTDA梯度和NACME的解析导数，包括双杂化激发态的首个解析导数NACME。其实现方式为单一收缩图的反向模式转置，该图闭合于非对称原子轨道直J/K核下。所有计算采用设备驻留和原子轨道直方法，通过共享的Cholesky分解J/K引擎运行，并采用profile引导的~10²倍发射折叠技术保持双精度位一致性。
AI.result: 双杂化激发能将垂直激发平均绝对偏差从裸hhTDA的0.86 eV降至0.47 eV，消除+0.53→+0.05 eV的过激发偏差，改善了十个态中的七个，但过校正了离子性ππ*态（这是预期中的微扰双激发失效，未作裁剪）。所有耦合通过与独立字面多电子波函数重叠Oracle对照验证到~10⁻⁴精度，该Oracle不共享任何代码路径。在氨n→σ*共价锥形交叉点处具有物理意义，hhTDA/ppTDA流形恢复F-2缝，而绝热线性响应TDDFT构建上给出τ≡0。所有实现在8GB的消费级RTX 4060上完成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将相关激发态导数能力（梯度、NACME和双杂化耦合）从数据中心硬件下放到消费级桌面显卡（RTX 4060），由单一Cholesky分解J/K引擎统一支持，为大规模非绝热动力学模拟提供了可及的、精确的双杂化泛函工具。

title: Universal Magnetoresistance Scaling in Layered Pd-based Multiband Metals Beyond Compensated Semimetal Regime
summary: We systematically investigated the magnetoresistance ratio (MR) of single-crystalline, nonmagnetic layered Pd-based metals, including centrosymmetric PdTe2, PdPb2, and beta-PdBi2 and noncentrosymmetric alpha-PdBi. Our study identifies a distinct class of large MR in multiband, high-carrier-density systems. Unlike well-studied extremely large MR materials, such as Dirac and Weyl semimetals described by simple compensated-carrier models, these compounds possess complex Fermi surfaces, as validated by our first-principles calculations. Nevertheless, they exhibit a remarkably simple MR scaling governed by carrier mobility, manifested in systematic dependencies on magnetic field, temperature, and the residual resistivity ratio (RRR). The validity of Kohler's rule in high-RRR crystals indicates that MR is governed by a single effective scattering time, even in these multiband systems. The field and RRR dependences of MR follow an intermediate power-law behavior between linear and quadratic, attributable to imperfect carrier compensation and a distribution of carrier mobilities. Among the studied compounds, alpha-PdBi exhibits the largest MR, reaching 1500% (2 K, 7 T), owing to its exceptionally high RRR (approximately 660). However, when compared on an equal-RRR basis, its MR is smaller than that of its centrosymmetric counterparts. This trend suggests that additional scattering channels arising from spin-orbit-induced band splitting in noncentrosymmetric systems reduce the effective carrier mobility. Our results establish a new class of large MR in clean multiband metals where complex electronic structures give rise to emergent single-parameter scaling, highlighting the interplay between disorder, mobility, and symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了非磁性层状Pd基金属（包括中心对称的PdTe2、PdPb2、β-PdBi2和非中心对称的α-PdBi）的磁阻比（MR），发现了一类在多能带、高载流子密度系统中具有大磁阻的新材料类别。这些材料具有复杂费米面，但展现出由载流子迁移率控制的简单MR标度关系。
AI.motivation: 已有的大磁阻研究主要集中于Dirac和Weyl半金属等简单补偿载流子模型描述的极少数体系，对于具有复杂电子结构的多能带金属中的大磁阻现象缺乏系统性理解。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算验证复杂费米面，通过系统的磁阻测量研究磁场、温度和剩余电阻率比（RRR）的依赖关系，检验Kohler规则的适用性，并对比中心对称与非中心对称体系的磁阻行为。
AI.result: 这些多能带体系展现出简单的MR标度关系，由载流子迁移率控制。高RRR晶体满足Kohler规则。磁场和RRR依赖呈介于线性和二次之间的幂律行为。α-PdBi在2K、7T下MR达1500%（RRR约660），但在等RRR比较下其MR小于中心对称对应物。
AI.conclusion: 确立了洁净多能带金属中一类新的大磁阻现象，其中复杂电子结构产生了涌现的单参数标度，揭示了无序、迁移率与对称性之间的相互作用。非中心对称体系中自旋轨道诱导的能带劈裂产生的额外散射通道会降低有效载流子迁移率。

title: Entanglement Mpemba Effect
summary: Generating entanglement rapidly and reliably is essential for quantum information processing, communication, and metrology. Dissipative preparation is attractive because engineered reservoirs robustly drive a system toward an entangled target, yet relaxation can carry a substantial time cost. Here we formulate the entanglement Mpemba effect, whereby an initially less entangled state overtakes a more entangled state under the same open-system dynamics. This effect turns initial-state engineering into a route for faster preparation without altering the dissipative protocol. We derive a general criterion for the reversal from the relaxation spectrum, applicable even when entanglement evolves nonmonotonically. A reversal of deterministic local operations and classical communication (LOCC)-reachability preorder provides a measure-independent certificate of reversed entanglement order. Exactly solvable models show that initial-state selection can substantially shorten the time required to reach high entanglement. We further propose an experimentally relevant trapped-ion protocol that can realize the entanglement Mpemba effect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"纠缠姆潘巴效应"，即在一个开放量子系统的耗散演化中，初始纠缠度较低的状态可以超越初始纠缠度较高的状态，率先达到目标纠缠态。该效应使得初始态工程成为一种无需改变耗散协议的加速纠缠制备方案，并通过理论判据和实验方案（囚禁离子）验证了其可行性。
AI.motivation: 纠缠态的快速可靠制备对量子信息处理、通信和计量至关重要。耗散制备虽能稳健地将系统驱动向纠缠目标态，但弛豫过程往往耗时较长。作者希望找到一种不改变耗散协议本身、仅通过初始态选择来加速纠缠制备的方法。
AI.method: 作者从弛豫谱中推导出纠缠序反转的一般判据，该判据即使在纠缠非单调演化时也适用。通过确定性LOCC可达性序的反转，提供了一种与度量无关的纠缠序反转证明。同时利用精确可解模型进行分析，并提出了囚禁离子实验方案来实现该效应。
AI.result: 精确可解的模型表明，初始态的选择可以显著缩短达到高纠缠所需的时间。作者提出的囚禁离子协议能够实际实现纠缠姆潘巴效应，验证了该理论框架的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 纠缠姆潘巴效应将初始态工程转化为加速纠缠制备的新途径，无需改变耗散协议本身，为量子信息处理中的快速纠缠制备提供了新的理论框架和实验路线。

title: Observation of metastable chiral domain walls in a topological magnet
summary: The interplay between topology and correlation can give rise to exotic collective excitations. The integer and fractional quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) magnets recently discovered in two-dimensional (2D) flatband systems are predicted to host spin excitations distinct from those in conventional magnets. Experimentally, nevertheless, these new excitations remain largely unexplored. Here we investigate spin-valley excitations in a twisted MoTe2 moiré superlattice using resonant ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy. We observe a metastable spin-valley excitation in the QAH magnet below T ~ 3.7 K that survives reverse magnetic field several times larger than the saturation field. The behavior of this excitation is sharply distinct from ordinary domain walls and magnons, indicating a new type of spin-valley textures unique to topological magnets. We propose that these textures are chiral domain walls with an in-plane winding of the pseudospin order parameter along the domain wall. Their metastability arises from the interplay between the topological winding in real space and the quantum geometry of the parent bands in momentum space through a universal mechanism. These chiral domain walls govern the nonequilibrium dynamics of QAH magnets and may play a central role in their stability. Our study highlights intrinsic quantum geometry effects on spin excitations in topological magnets; and provides key insights into the fundamental mechanism limiting stability of topological protection.

AI.tldr: 本文利用共振超快泵浦-探测光谱研究了扭曲MoTe2莫尔超晶格中的自旋-谷激发，在量子反常霍尔（QAH）磁体中观察到一种亚稳态自旋-谷激发，该激发在远高于饱和场的反向磁场下仍然存活，其行为与普通畴壁和磁振子截然不同，表明这是一种拓扑磁体独有的新型自旋-谷织构——手性畴壁。
AI.motivation: 二维平带系统中的整数和分数量子反常霍尔磁体被预测具有不同于传统磁体的自旋激发，但实验上这些新激发尚未被探索。理解这些激发对于揭示拓扑与关联的相互作用以及拓扑保护的稳定性机制至关重要。
AI.method: 采用共振超快泵浦-探测光谱技术研究扭曲MoTe2莫尔超晶格中的自旋-谷激发，探测其在低温（T~3.7K）及反向磁场下的行为特性。
AI.result: 在QAH磁体中观察到亚稳态自旋-谷激发，该激发在远大于饱和场的反向磁场下仍存活，其行为明显区别于普通畴壁和磁振子，表明是拓扑磁体特有的新型自旋-谷织构。
AI.conclusion: 提出了手性畴壁模型：沿畴壁具有赝自旋序参量的面内缠绕。其亚稳性源于实空间拓扑缠绕与动量空间母带量子几何之间的相互作用，遵循普适机制。这些手性畴壁控制QAH磁体的非平衡动力学，并可能在其稳定性中起核心作用，揭示了拓扑磁体中自旋激发的本征量子几何效应，为拓扑保护的稳定性机制提供了关键见解。

title: A robust and efficient solver for coupled cluster equations
summary: The coupled-cluster (CC) equations are most frequently solved via fixed-point (FP) iterations. However, when formulated in a non-canonical gauge, as in local correlation CC, the FP iteration may converge slowly or even diverge. Practical fixes, such as level-shifting and a direct inversion of iterative subspace (DIIS), often improve the convergence, but remain fundamentally heuristic and gauge dependent. {\it Yang et al.}~demonstrated that preconditioned Newton--Krylov (PNK) methods provide substantial wall-time advantage for canonical CC. In this work, we generalize the preconditioner to arbitrary gauges by replacing the energy denominator with a gauge-invariant formulation. Combined with Krylov-based approximate Jacobian inversion, the resulting framework removes the need for level-shifting and yields robust and efficient convergence across various gauges and challenging chemical systems. Our numerical results indicate that PNK consistently outperforms carefully optimized FP-based approaches across a range of molecular systems, positioning the proposed PNK method as a promising new standard for solving the CC equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将预条件牛顿-克雷洛夫（PNK）方法推广到任意规范（非正则规范）的耦合簇（CC）方程求解框架，通过用规范不变的公式替代能量分母来构造预条件子，并配合基于Krylov的近似雅可比逆，消除了对level-shifting的需求，在不同规范和复杂化学体系中实现了鲁棒且高效的收敛。数值结果表明PNK在多个分子体系中始终优于精心优化的定点迭代方法，有望成为求解CC方程的新标准。
AI.motivation: 传统的耦合簇方程求解主要依赖定点（FP）迭代，但在非正则规范（如局域相关CC）下，FP迭代可能收敛缓慢甚至发散。现有的修复方案（如level-shifting和DIIS）本质上是启发式的且依赖规范，缺乏理论保证。而Yang等人证明的PNK方法虽在正则CC中表现优异，但其预条件子依赖能量分母，无法直接推广到任意规范。
AI.method: 本文的核心创新在于将对角预条件子中的能量分母替换为规范不变的表达式，从而将PNK方法推广到任意规范。结合基于Krylov子空间的近似雅可比逆技术，构建了一个无需level-shifting的通用求解框架，适用于各种规范和具有挑战性的化学体系。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该PNK方法在多个分子体系中对多种规范均表现出稳健且高效的收敛性，且始终优于经过精心优化的基于定点迭代的方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的规范不变PNK方法克服了传统FP迭代在非正则规范下收敛性的缺陷，为求解CC方程提供了一个稳健、高效且规范无关的新标准，具有广阔的推广应用前景。

title: Local magnetic properties of the rare-earth intermetallics $R$Mn$_2$Ge$_2$ ($R$=Ce, Pr, Nd)
summary: We present an investigation of the rare-earth intermetallic materials, $R$Mn$_2$Ge$_2$ ($R$=Ce, Pr, Nd), reported to host a lattice of skyrmionic bubbles at room temperature. The magnetism of all three materials is characterised by the onset of local fluctuations as the magnetic state changes from a conical magnetic structure to a collinear antiferromagnetic one as temperature $T$ is increased. In this $T$ regime, where skyrmion-bubble textures have been reported, we see dynamics similar to those observed in other skyrmion-hosting materials. The level of disorder above this transition increases across the series from $R$=Ce to Nd. At low temperatures the magnetism is affected by the ordering of the rare-earth ions, resulting in distinct behaviour for the different members of the series.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了稀土金属间化合物RMn₂Ge₂（R=Ce, Pr, Nd）的磁性特性。这些材料在室温下被认为拥有斯格明子气泡晶格。三种材料的磁性特征表现为随着温度升高，磁结构从锥形结构转变为共线反铁磁结构时出现局域波动的起始。在这个报道存在斯格明子气泡纹理的温度区间，观察到了与其他斯格明子宿主材料相似的动力学行为。从Ce到Nd，该转变之上的无序程度增加。低温下磁性受稀土离子有序化的影响，不同系列成员表现出不同的行为。
AI.motivation: 探索室温下具有斯格明子气泡晶格的稀土金属间化合物RMn₂Ge₂（R=Ce, Pr, Nd）的磁性特性，理解其磁结构转变和动力学行为。
AI.method: 对RMn₂Ge₂（R=Ce, Pr, Nd）三种材料进行磁性表征，研究温度升高过程中磁结构从锥形结构到共线反铁磁结构的转变，观察局域波动的起始以及低温下稀土离子有序化的影响。
AI.result: 三种材料均表现出磁结构转变过程中的局域波动；在斯格明子气泡报告的温度区间观察到与其他斯格明子宿主材料相似的动力学；从Ce到Nd转变之上的无序程度递增；低温下稀土离子有序化导致不同系列成员呈现不同磁性行为。
AI.conclusion: RMn₂Ge₂系列材料在室温附近具有斯格明子气泡相关的磁场特性，但不同稀土元素成员在无序程度和低温行为上存在显著差异，需针对每个成员分别理解其磁性机制。

title: Tunable g-Factors of Hybridized Orbitals in a Quantum Dot Molecule
summary: The ability to control the $g$-factors of orbital spin states in optically active quantum dot molecules (QDMs) is a prerequisite for the high-fidelity generation of multi-photonic cluster states with higher-dimensional entanglement structure. Protocols that rely on two coupled spins require knowledge of the $g$-factor and its dependence on external control parameters. Mismatches in the $g$-factor between tunnel-coupled dots introduce unwanted dephasing of coupled spin-states, making precise characterization and voltage control essential. Here, we measure the gate voltage dependence of the electron and hole $g$-factors of negatively charged trions $X^{-}$ in a single InGaAs QDM using polarization-resolved magneto-photoluminescence spectroscopy. The electron $g$-factor exhibits a pronounced step-like change at the tunneling resonance, shifting from $g_\mathrm{e} = -0.336\pm 0.008$ to $g_\mathrm{e} = -0.389\pm 0.003$, providing a direct spectroscopic fingerprint of molecular orbital formation and a shift of the wavefunction localization from the lower to the upper dot. In contrast, the hole $g$-factor remains nearly constant at $g_\mathrm{h} \approx 0.094 \pm 0.007$, exhibiting a weak modulation near the anticrossing voltages attributed to Coulomb-mediated deformation of the wavefunction by the tunneling electron. Our results are quantitatively reproduced by an eight-band $\mathbf{k}{\cdot}\mathbf{p}$ model, establishing electric-field control of the trion $g$-factors as a practical tool for independently tuning the Zeeman splitting of individual dots and opening new pathways towards the deterministic generation of two-dimensional photonic cluster states.

AI.tldr: 本文通过偏振分辨磁光致发光光谱，系统测量了InGaAs量子点分子中负电荷三激子X⁻的电子和空穴g因子随栅极电压的依赖关系。电子g因子在隧穿共振处呈现明显的阶梯式变化（从-0.336到-0.389），这是分子轨道形成的直接光谱指纹；而空穴g因子基本保持恒定（约0.094），仅在反交叉电压附近有微弱调制。八带k·p模型定量重现了实验结果，确立了通过电场独立调控各量子点塞曼分裂的实用方案。
AI.motivation: 控制量子点分子中轨道自旋态的g因子是产生高维纠缠结构多光子簇态的前提。隧穿耦合点之间的g因子失配会引入耦合自旋态的不希望的退相干，因此精确表征和电压控制g因子至关重要。
AI.method: 采用偏振分辨磁光致发光光谱技术，对单个InGaAs量子点分子中X⁻三激子的电子和空穴g因子进行栅极电压依赖测量，并结合八带k·p模型进行定量理论模拟。
AI.result: 电子g因子在隧穿共振处发生显著阶梯式变化，从g_e=-0.336±0.008跃迁至g_e=-0.389±0.003，表明波函数从下量子点向上量子点转移；空穴g因子几乎恒定在0.094±0.007，仅在反交叉电压附近有由库仑介导的弱调制。实验结果被八带k·p模型定量重现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了电场控制三激子g因子作为独立调节各量子点塞曼分裂的实用工具，为确定性生成二维光子簇态开辟了新途径。

title: High-temperature simulation of the Raman spectra of the isotopologues $^{13}$C$^{16}$O$_2$ and $^{16}$O$^{13}$C$^{18}$O
summary: Recently, experimental Raman spectra of the isotopologues $^{13}$C$^{16}$O$_2$ and $^{16}$O$^{13}$C$^{18}$O at high temperature have been reported. Separately, a reliable approach for obtaining vibrational wave functions for most isotopologues has been proposed. These descriptions, based on the $SU_1(2)\times U(3)\times SU_2(2)$ dynamical group, provide spectroscopic-quality fits to vibrational term values with root-mean-square deviations of $0.06$ and $0.07~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$, respectively. Using the resulting wave functions, we simulate the Raman spectra of both species by evaluating transition moments of the mean polarizability, represented as an expansion in curvilinear coordinates up to cubic terms within the same algebraic framework. The difference of two independent experimental Raman spectra under comparable temperature conditions is analyzed with the help of the simulations provided by our model. The resulting simulations show excellent agreement with experiment, reinforcing the reliability of the model, while the estimated transition moments are also consistent with experimental values.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于SU1(2)×U(3)×SU2(2)动力学群框架，利用代数方法模拟了高温下13C16O2和16O13C18O两种CO2同位素体的振动波函数和Raman光谱，通过与实验光谱对比验证了模型的可靠性，并给出了与实验一致的跃迁矩估计。
AI.motivation: 实验上已报道了高温下两种CO2同位素体的Raman光谱，需要使用可靠的量子化学/代数方法模拟这些实验数据，以验证理论模型的准确性，并深入理解同位素效应对振动结构和光谱性质的影响。
AI.method: 采用基于SU1(2)×U(3)×SU2(2)动力学群的代数框架，对振动能级进行光谱级精度的拟合（RMS偏差分别为0.06和0.07 cm^-1）；利用得到的振动波函数，将平均极化率展开为曲线坐标下的立方项，在该代数框架内计算跃迁矩并模拟两种同位素体的高温Raman光谱。
AI.result: 模拟结果与实验Raman光谱高度一致，验证了模型可靠性；同时，通过模拟辅助分析了两个独立实验光谱（在相近温度条件下）的差异；估算的跃迁矩也与实验值相符。
AI.conclusion: 该代数模型能够高精度地复现CO2同位素体的高温Raman光谱，不仅验证了动力学群方法的可靠性，还为进一步研究同位素效应对分子光谱的影响提供了有效工具。

title: Giant-exchange-driven Vectorial Control of a Minimal Topological Magnet in Eu3In2As4
summary: The interplay between magnetism and band topology provides a route to controlling quantum states of matter, yet its realization in materials is often constrained by weak exchange coupling and complex electronic structures. Here, a giant exchange coupling is identified in the newly predicted topological magnet Eu3In2As4, giving rise to magnetization-dependent band shifts of up to 300 meV. Together with its intrinsically soft magnetic response, this strong cou-pling enables systematic tuning of topological phases by both the magnitude and orientation of applied magnetic fields. The magneto-topological phase diagram is mapped out in which an antiferromagnetic topological insulator ground state evolves, under modest fields, into a pro-posed intermediate 2/3-ferrimagnetic phase, and further into fully polarized ferromagnetic states predicted to host either Weyl or nodal-ring semimetals. Notably, the Weyl phase corresponds to a minimal model hosting a single pair of Weyl nodes. Quantum oscillations, anomalous Hall transport and magneto-infrared spectroscopy consistently reveal exchange-driven band recon-struction across these transitions. Rotation of the magnetization theoretically provides an effi-cient means to tune the momentum-space positions and separations of the Weyl nodes. These results establish Eu3In2As4 as a model system for exploring how strong exchange coupling can be used to control topological band structures with minimal complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了新型拓扑磁体Eu3In2As4中巨大的交换耦合效应（能带偏移高达300 meV），通过磁场的大小和方向可以系统调控其拓扑相，绘制出从反铁磁拓扑绝缘体到2/3亚铁磁相，再到铁磁Weyl或节线半金属的完整磁拓扑相图。
AI.motivation: 磁性-拓扑相互作用为控制量子态提供了途径，但实际材料中常受限于弱交换耦合和复杂电子结构，需要一个具有强交换耦合且电子结构简单的模型系统来研究磁拓扑调控。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理预测和多种实验手段（量子振荡、反常霍尔输运、磁红外光谱），表征Eu3In2As4的磁化依赖能带重构，并绘制磁拓扑相图；理论模拟旋转磁化方向调控Weyl节点位置和间距。
AI.result: 在Eu3In2As4中找到高达300 meV的巨大交换耦合导致的磁化依赖能带偏移，实现从反铁磁拓扑绝缘体到2/3亚铁磁相再到Weyl/节线半金属的可调拓扑转变，并发现单对Weyl节点的最小模型。
AI.conclusion: Eu3In2As4可作为研究强交换耦合控制拓扑带结构的理想模型系统，为磁拓扑材料的设计与调控提供了新平台。

title: Entwined lattice of atoms and anionic electrons in layered electride LaCl
summary: Controlling the lattice geometry that governs electronic structure is a central theme in condensed-matter physics, yet in crystalline solids this geometry is usually fixed by the atomic framework. Electrides offer an alternative route to electronic structure design in which their excess electrons can organize into anionic electron lattice (AEL) and provide a lattice-like degree of freedom. Recent work has highlighted the standalone limit, where the AEL in YCl yields bands well described by the dice-lattice model. Here, using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we show that LaCl, although isostructural to YCl, realizes a qualitatively different regime where the AEL is entwined with the La cation framework, producing a fully reconstructed electronic structure. Combining the ARPES result with tight-binding model analysis, we demonstrate that this radical divergence stems from the activation of direct hopping channels between the AEL and the La atomic lattice. This coupling reshapes the effective lattice geometry, reconstructs the electronic states, and modifies the associated Chern band topology, transforming the bipartite dice-lattice network in YCl into a tripartite structure in LaCl. Our findings demonstrate that the coupling between the AEL and the atomic lattice can actively shape the effective lattice geometry that governs the electronic structure. This coupling can act as a powerful tuning knob for electronic structure design that is inaccessible in conventional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和紧束缚模型分析，研究了同构的YCl和LaCl电化物中阴离子电子晶格（AEL）的不同行为。YCl中AEL独立形成dice晶格模型，而LaCl中AEL与阳离子框架耦合，导致电子结构完全重构，将二分的dice晶格网络转变为三分的结构，并改变了Chern带拓扑。
AI.motivation: 控制晶格几何是凝聚态物理的核心主题，但在传统晶体中几何通常由原子框架固定。电化物中的过剩电子可形成阴离子电子晶格（AEL），提供传统材料中不存在的晶格自由度。先前研究已展示AEL的独立极限（YCl中的dice晶格），但AEL与原子晶格耦合如何影响电子结构尚不清楚，本文旨在探索这一耦合调控电子结构设计的可能性。
AI.method: 使用ARPES测量LaCl的电子结构，并与YCl进行对比；结合紧束缚模型分析，研究AEL与La阳离子框架之间的直接跳跃通道对有效晶格几何、电子态重构和Chern带拓扑的影响。
AI.result: 发现LaCl虽与YCl同构，但实现了一个质的不同的物理区域：AEL与La阳离子框架纠缠耦合，导致电子结构完全重构。这种耦合源于AEL与La原子晶格之间直接跳跃通道的激活，将YCl中的二分dice晶格网络转变为LaCl中的三分结构，并相应改变了Chern带拓扑。
AI.conclusion: AEL与原子晶格之间的耦合能够主动塑造控制电子结构的有效晶格几何，可作为传统材料中不可用的强大电子结构设计调节旋钮，为电子结构工程开辟了新途径。

title: Physics-Grounded Materials Artificial Intelligence for Reliable Materials Discovery
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming materials discovery, yet conventional data-driven approaches often suffer from limited interpretability, poor extrapolation, and inconsistency with physical laws. Since materials behavior is fundamentally governed by thermodynamics, kinetics, electronic structure, transport processes, and operating environments, the next generation of materials intelligence must move beyond correlation-based prediction toward physics-grounded reasoning. In this Perspective, we systematically discuss Physics-Grounded Materials AI (PhysMat AI) as a unifying perspective for integrating physical knowledge into materials intelligence through five complementary roles: physics as prior knowledge, descriptors, constraints, verifiers, and infrastructure. Using representative examples from catalysis, solid-state electrolytes in solid-state battery, and hydrogen-storage materials, we illustrate how physical principles guide data representation, model reasoning, validation workflows, and knowledge management. We further present how AI agents can leverage these physics-aware components to perform mechanism-guided discovery within physically feasible search spaces. Finally, we outline a developmental roadmap from physics-aware AI to physics-reasoning AI and ultimately physics-autonomous AI. Looking forward, materials intelligence should evolve from predictive models toward autonomous scientific systems capable of integrating physical reasoning, multiscale simulations, experimental validation, and continuous knowledge updating for reliable materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"物理接地材料智能"（PhysMat AI）作为统一视角，系统讨论将物理知识以五种互补角色（先验知识、描述符、约束、验证器和基础设施）整合到材料智能中，并以催化、固态电解质和储氢材料为例进行阐述，最后提出从物理感知AI到物理推理AI再到物理自主AI的发展路线图。
AI.motivation: 传统数据驱动的材料AI方法存在可解释性有限、外推能力差以及与物理规律不一致的问题，而材料行为本质上受热力学、动力学、电子结构、输运过程和操作环境支配，因此下一代材料智能需要超越基于相关性的预测，转向基于物理的推理。
AI.method: 提出PhysMat AI框架，将物理知识通过五种互补角色整合进材料智能：(1)作为先验知识，(2)作为描述符，(3)作为约束，(4)作为验证器，(5)作为基础设施；同时探讨AI智能体如何利用这些物理感知组件在物理可行的搜索空间内进行机制引导的发现。
AI.result: 通过催化、固态电池固态电解质和储氢材料三个代表性案例，展示了物理原理如何指导数据表示、模型推理、验证工作流和知识管理，并论证了AI智能体结合物理感知组件实现机制引导发现的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 材料智能应从预测模型演进为自主科学系统，整合物理推理、多尺度模拟、实验验证和持续知识更新，实现可靠的自主材料发现，最终目标是物理自主AI。

title: Electron Temperature and Electron-Electron Scattering Length in GaAs/AlGaAs Using Mesoscopic Multiparallel Aperture Geometries
summary: Quantifying electron temperatures and electron-electron scattering lengths is essential for understanding electron transport regimes in two-dimensional systems. To that end, this work experimentally investigates low-temperature ballistic transport using semiclassical cyclotron orbits in a multiparallel aperture geometry. The mesoscopic geometry is fabricated on a GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure of very high electron mobility. The amplitudes of maxima in magnetoresistance due to ballistic transport are observed to decay exponentially with temperature, allowing determination of the electron-electron scattering length from the data. A quantitative relation between electron temperature and an applied dc bias heating current is established by comparing magnetoresistance peak amplitudes measured as a function of temperature and dc bias, reflecting bias-induced Joule heating. In addition, the resistance measured near zero magnetic field decreases with increasing temperature, providing signatures of superballistic conductance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多平行孔径几何结构中的半经典回旋轨道实验，在低温弹道输运条件下量化了电子温度与电子-电子散射长度。研究发现磁阻极大值幅度随温度呈指数衰减，从而测定电子-电子散射长度；并通过比较温度与直流偏压下的磁阻峰幅度，建立了电子温度与偏压加热电流之间的定量关系。近零磁场电阻随温度升高而降低的现象则为超弹道电导提供了证据。
AI.motivation: 量化电子温度和电子-电子散射长度对于理解二维系统中的电子输运机制至关重要，此前缺乏系统的实验研究。
AI.method: 在超高迁移率的GaAs/AlGaAs异质结上制备多平行孔径介观结构，利用半经典回旋轨道测量低温弹道输运；通过分析磁阻峰幅度随温度的指数衰减提取电子-电子散射长度，并对比温度和直流偏压下的峰幅度变化建立定量关系。
AI.result: 磁阻最大值幅度随温度指数衰减，成功测定电子-电子散射长度；建立了电子温度与直流偏压加热电流之间的定量关系；观察到近零磁场电阻随温度升高而降低的迹象，暗示超弹道电导的存在。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种有效的实验方法用于量化二维系统中的电子温度和电子-电子散射长度，并揭示了超弹道输运现象，深化了对二维电子输运机制的理解。

title: Permutation invariant neural network prediction of vacancy formation under deformation and varying chemical environment in FCC high entropy alloys
summary: Vacancy formation energies govern diffusion, irradiation damage, phase stability, and dynamic failure in high-entropy alloys (HEAs), yet their strong dependence on local chemical environments and mechanical deformation makes atomistic calculations prohibitively expensive for large-scale studies. Here, we develop an atomistically informed permutation invariant machine learning framework for predicting strain dependent vacancy formation energies in FCC HEAs from local atomic environments. The model employs a vacancy-centered representation constructed from objective geometric descriptors together with invariants of the local deformation gradient, enabling the coupled effects of chemical disorder and finite deformation to be learned within a unified framework.
