Atomistic simulations reveal that volumetric deformation is the dominant factor controlling the average variation in vacancy formation energy, whereas shear deformation has a comparatively minor influence. At the same time, substantial site to site variability persists under identical macroscopic loading, demonstrating that local chemical environments govern the statistical distribution of vacancy energetics beyond species-averaged trends. The proposed framework accurately predicts vacancy formation energies across diverse deformation states while providing orders-of-magnitude faster evaluation than direct atomistic simulations. These results establish an efficient route for incorporating stress-dependent defect energetics into multiscale models of diffusion, irradiation damage, and dynamic failure in chemically complex alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于原子信息的置换不变机器学习框架，用于预测FCC高熵合金中依赖应变的空位形成能。该模型采用空位中心表示，结合几何描述符和局部变形梯度不变量，统一学习化学无序与有限变形的耦合效应。研究发现体积变形是控制空位形成能平均变化的主导因素，而剪切变形影响较小；同时局部化学环境决定了空位能量的统计分布。该框架在多种变形状态下准确预测空位形成能，且比直接原子模拟快数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 高熵合金中的空位形成能对扩散、辐照损伤、相稳定性和动态失效至关重要，但其对局部化学环境和机械变形的强依赖性使得大规模原子计算代价过高，亟需高效的预测方法。
AI.method: 提出置换不变的机器学习框架，采用空位中心表示，由客观几何描述符与局部变形梯度不变量共同构建特征，在统一框架中学习化学无序与有限变形的耦合效应；通过原子模拟数据训练并验证模型。
AI.result: 体积变形是空位形成能平均变化的主导因素，剪切变形影响较小；相同宏观载荷下仍存在显著的位点间差异，表明局部化学环境主导空位能量统计分布。模型在多种变形状态下准确预测空位形成能，且计算速度比直接原子模拟快数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为将应力相关的缺陷能量学纳入化学复杂合金的多尺度模型（如扩散、辐照损伤和动态失效）提供了高效途径。

title: Optical Anisotropy and Phase Matching in Non-Centrosymmetric Perovskite Oxides from DFT+U and DFT+U+V Functionals
summary: Optical anisotropy underpins the operation and performance of a broad range of photonic and quantum technologies. In this work, we critically examine the accuracy of density functional theory approximations with onsite and intersite Hubbard corrections (the DFT+$U$ and DFT+$U$+$V$ functionals) in predicting the anisotropic optical response of the non-centrosymmetric perovskite oxides, such as BaTiO$_3$, LiNbO$_3$, KNbO$_3$, and PbTiO$_3$. It is found that correcting self-interaction errors using DFT+$U$ alone does not capture the optoelectronic response of these materials, often leading to a suppression of their optical anisotropy. While intersite Hubbard interactions restore this anisotropy, the choice of the (inter)atomic orbital manifold that defines the Hubbard correction remains critical to its accuracy. The predictive performance of the resulting, systematically validated DFT+$U$+$V$ functional is achieved at a fraction of the computational cost of hybrid functionals and many-body perturbation theory calculations. As benchmarks, we investigate Zn- and (Bi,Mn)-substituted BaTiO$_3$ solid solutions; the latter exhibit polarization-dependent bandgap narrowing from mid-gap states, substantially enhancing the dichroic ratio and birefringence with promising implications for polarization-sensitive photodetectors and integrated photonics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了DFT+U和DFT+U+V泛函在预测非中心对称钙钛矿氧化物（BaTiO₃、LiNbO₃、KNbO₃、PbTiO₃）各向异性光学响应方面的准确性。研究发现仅靠DFT+U校正自相互作用误差无法捕捉这些材料的电子光学响应（常抑制光学各向异性），而引入原子间Hubbard相互作用（U+V）可以恢复各向异性，但轨道流形的选择至关重要。该方法的预测性能远优于杂化泛函和多体微扰论，计算成本仅为后者的极小部分。基准测试表明，Zn和(Bi,Mn)掺杂的BaTiO₃固溶体中，极化相关的带隙窄化显著增强了二向色比和双折射，对偏振敏感光电探测器与集成光子学有重要应用前景。
AI.motivation: 光学各向异性是许多光子学和量子技术运行与性能的基础，但密度泛函理论（DFT）在预测非中心对称钙钛矿氧化物的各向异性光学响应时存在自相互作用误差问题。现有的DFT+U方法被认为不足以准确描述这类材料的光电子响应，因此需要系统评估并改进DFT+U和DFT+U+V泛函的预测能力，以在较低计算成本下获得与杂化泛函或多体微扰论相当的精度。
AI.method: 作者系统比较了DFT+U（仅原子内Hubbard校正）与DFT+U+V（包含原子间Hubbard校正）两种泛函在多种非中心对称钙钛矿氧化物上的表现，考察了不同(原子间)轨道流形对Hubbard校正精度的影响。同时以Zn和(Bi,Mn)取代的BaTiO₃固溶体作为基准体系进行验证，评估极化相关的带隙窄化对二向色比和双折射的影响。
AI.result: DFT+U单独使用会抑制光学各向异性，无法准确预测这些材料的电子光学响应；DFT+U+V则能恢复各向异性，但其精度高度依赖于(原子间)轨道流形的选择。经系统验证的DFT+U+V方法在极低计算成本下达到了接近杂化泛函和多体微扰论的预测性能。(Bi,Mn)取代的BaTiO₃表现出极化依赖的带隙窄化和中隙态，显著增强了二向色比和双折射。
AI.conclusion: DFT+U+V泛函是一种兼具准确性和计算效率的实用方法，能够可靠预测非中心对称钙钛矿氧化物的各向异性光学响应。极化相关的带隙窄化效应为偏振敏感光电探测器和集成光子学器件提供了有前景的材料设计思路。

title: A quantum geometric mechanism for chiral domain wall metastability: Application to twisted transition-metal dichalcogenides
summary: Band topology can have an imprint on the excitations of a ferromagnet. A known example is quantum Hall ferromagnets and their lattice analogs; when both flavors have the same Chern number $C$, a smooth skyrmion texture binds charge $-eC$ per unit winding. Here, we consider instead the case of conjugate Chern bands related by time-reversal. We show that, despite the vanishing net charge response, a smooth texture can be associated with a dipole response---a domain wall (DW) with an in-plane winding along its length can bind a nonzero dipole density transverse to the wall. The strength of this dipole density is controlled by a dimensionless coefficient $c_G$. Although not quantized, the geometric dipole coefficient $c_G$ is a moment of the second Chern form of the occupied projector in mixed (momentum and order-parameter) space and is generally nonzero. The dipole-decorated DW can thus become metastable at a finite radius due to the competition between dipolar repulsion and the usual surface tension, even at a finite Zeeman field. In a realistic model of twisted MoTe$_2$, we find that $c_G$ drops sharply across a transition within the valley-polarized (VP) phase from a $C=1$ to a $C=0$ ferromagnet. This naturally explains recent pump-probe experiments~\cite{exp} at hole filling $ν=1$, in which a long-lived excitation survives reverse fields far exceeding the saturation field but disappears at an intermediate displacement field despite only weak changes in conventional magnetic diagnostics. Metastable spin textures thus serve as a sensitive probe of band quantum geometry, and as an intrinsic bottleneck for fast optical control of moiré ferromagnets in Chern-conjugate bands.

AI.tldr: 本文研究共轭Chern能带（由时间反演联系）中的拓扑自旋纹理。与量子霍尔铁磁体不同，在无净电荷响应的情况下，平滑纹理可产生偶极响应——沿长度方向具有面内缠绕的畴壁可在垂直于壁的方向束缚非零偶极密度。该偶极密度强度由几何偶极系数c_G控制，c_G是混合空间中占据投影子第二Chern形式的矩，一般不为零。在扭曲MoTe₂模型中，c_G在谷极化相内C=1到C=0的转变处急剧下降，自然解释了近期泵浦-探测实验中长寿命激发超越饱和场却在中间位移场消失的现象。
AI.motivation: 带拓扑对铁磁体激发的影响是凝聚态物理的重要问题。已知量子霍尔铁磁体可通过平滑skyrmion纹理束缚电荷，但此前研究主要集中于相同Chern数的情况。作者关注共轭Chern能带（时间反演相联系）情形，此时净电荷响应为零，需要探索是否存在其他形式的拓扑响应。此外，近期扭曲MoTe₂泵浦-探测实验观察到传统磁诊断难以解释的长寿命激发行为，需要理论机制来解释。
AI.method: 作者从理论上证明：在共轭Chern能带中，平滑纹理可产生偶极响应而非电荷响应。关键物理量是几何偶极系数c_G，它定义为混合（动量与有序参数）空间中占据投影子第二Chern形式的矩，虽未量子化但一般非零。畴壁沿长度方向具有面内缠绕时可束缚横向偶极密度，偶极排斥与表面张力竞争可使有限半径的畴壁成为亚稳态，即使在有限Zeeman场下也成立。作者在扭曲MoTe₂的真实模型中计算c_G，并分析其在谷极化相内C=1到C=0转变附近的行为。
AI.result: 在扭曲MoTe₂模型中，c_G在谷极化相内从C=1到C=0铁磁体的转变处急剧下降。这一行为自然解释了在空穴填充ν=1下的泵浦-探测实验：长寿命激发在反向场远超饱和场时仍然存活，但在中间位移场处消失，尽管传统磁诊断只有微弱变化。c_G的急剧变化对应了从稳定到不稳定自旋纹理的转变，与实验观测吻合。
AI.conclusion: 亚稳态自旋纹理可作为能带量子几何的灵敏探针，同时也是Chern共轭能带中moiré铁磁体快速光学控制的固有瓶颈。该工作揭示了共轭Chern能带中拓扑响应的新形式——几何偶极响应，为理解带拓扑与磁性激发的关联提供了新视角。

title: 3D Molecular Representation Learning for Organic Mixtures: Viscosity and Density Prediction
summary: The viscosity and density of organic mixtures are essential properties for designing lubricants, solvents, and heat transfer fluids. In engineering practice, formulating a functional fluid requires understanding how these properties change with composition and temperature. However, exhaustive experimental characterization across the full parameter space is impractical due to the vast number of possible species and combinations. Here we introduce a mixture-aware 3D molecular representation learning strategy, built upon a pre-trained molecular encoder, that jointly encodes component structures, mole fractions, and temperature to achieve accurate predictions for organic mixtures. Fine-tuning on publicly available datasets covering a wide range of binary organic mixtures yields test-set R2 values of 0.973 for dynamic viscosity and 0.996 for density, significantly outperforming traditional machine learning baselines. Beyond this overall accuracy, the model captures non-monotonic viscosity changes upon mixing, surpassing simple linear or logarithmic mixing rules. The architecture is extendable to ternary and multicomponent mixtures, as verified via preliminary experiments. Using this model, we quantitatively analyze how molecular structure-branching, cycloalkane, and aromatic rings-affects viscosity-temperature behavior, which benefits the design of lubricants with superior viscosity-temperature performance. Altogether, this work provides a practical, data-driven tool for mixture property prediction, accelerating the rational formulation of functional fluids in chemical engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合感知的3D分子表示学习策略，基于预训练分子编码器，联合编码组分结构、摩尔分数和温度，实现对有机混合物动力粘度和密度的准确预测，测试集R²分别达0.973和0.996，并可扩展到三元及多组分混合物。
AI.motivation: 有机混合物的粘度和密度是设计润滑剂、溶剂和传热流体的关键性质，但穷举实验表征整个参数空间不切实际，因为可能的物种和组合数量庞大，需要一种高效的计算预测方法。
AI.method: 提出一种混合感知的3D分子表示学习策略，基于预训练分子编码器构建，联合编码组分结构、摩尔分数和温度三个维度信息，在公开数据集上进行微调训练，并支持三元及多组分混合物的扩展。
AI.result: 在二元有机混合物数据集上，动态粘度预测R²达0.973，密度预测R²达0.996，显著优于传统机器学习基线；模型能捕捉混合时粘度的非单调变化，优于简单线性或对数混合规则，并在三元混合物初步实验中验证了可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为混合物性质预测提供了实用的数据驱动工具，可定量分析分子结构（支链、环烷烃、芳香环）对粘度-温度行为的影响，加速功能流体的理性配方设计。

title: Floquet spintronics: tuning the current-induced spin polarization of topological surface states with light
summary: Topological surface states are a promising platform for spintronics due to spin-momentum locking. Spin-momentum locking can induce a net spin polarization in topological surface states via an electric current, a phenomenon known as the Edelstein effect. In this work, using Floquet theory, we show that the current-induced spin polarization of topological surface states can be tuned by illuminating them with light, thereby modifying their spin texture in momentum space. Specifically, the electric spin susceptibility of topological surface states can be controlled and even reversed by varying the electric-field strength of high-frequency, circularly polarized light.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Floquet理论研究了光照射对拓扑表面态电流诱导自旋极化的调控作用，发现高频圆偏振光可以通过改变动量空间中的自旋纹理，来控制和甚至反转拓扑表面态的电自旋极化率。
AI.motivation: 拓扑表面态因自旋-动量锁定而成为自旋电子学的有前景平台，电流可诱导净自旋极化（Edelstein效应）。探索如何通过外部手段（如光照）调控这一效应，以实现更灵活的自旋操控。
AI.method: 采用Floquet理论分析高频圆偏振光照射下拓扑表面态的电子结构变化，计算光场影响下的电自旋极化率（electric spin susceptibility），考察其随光电场强度的变化规律。
AI.result: 发现通过改变高频圆偏振光的电场强度，可以控制和甚至反转拓扑表面态的电自旋极化率，从而实现电流诱导自旋极化的可调控性。
AI.conclusion: 光照提供了一种有效的外部调控手段，可通过修改动量空间自旋纹理来实现对拓扑表面态Edelstein效应的灵活操控，拓展了其在自旋电子学中的应用潜力。

title: Symmetry Classification of Non-Relativistic Hidden Spin Polarization in Noncollinear Magnets
summary: Hidden spin polarization (HSP), in which spin-polarized states exist locally while the total spin polarization are hidden in momentum space, has been extensively studied in nonmagnetic and collinear magnetic systems, but remains largely unexplored in noncollinear magnets. Here we establish a unified symmetry framework for HSP in noncollinear magnetic materials based on spin-group theory. We show that spin symmetries systematically constrain nonrelativistic spin polarization, giving rise to four distinct split spin-texture (SST) types for each local sector, denoted as SST-1, SST-2, SST-3, and SST-4. Based on these splitting forms, together with the dimensionality of the associated local spin textures and the symmetry relations between different local sectors, we further classify HSP into three categories: HSP-1, HSP-2, and HSP-3. We illustrate these categories using tight-binding models and representative material examples, including SrFe$_2$Se$_2$O, USb, Sr$_2$Mn$_3$Sb$_2$O$_2$, PrFeAsO, and GdMn$_2$Si$_2$. A survey of the MAGNDATA database further identifies 133, 7, and 139 candidate noncollinear magnetic materials hosting HSP-1, HSP-2, and HSP-3, respectively. In addition, our symmetry analysis and first-principles calculation show that many of these materials can exhibit nonzero spin-related response tensors. These results establish a general framework for understanding HSP in noncollinear magnets and highlight their potential for spin-dependent functionalities.

AI.tldr: 本文基于自旋群理论，为非线性磁性材料中的隐藏自旋极化（HSP）建立了统一的对称性框架，将其分类为三种类型（HSP-1, HSP-2, HSP-3），并通过紧束缚模型、材料实例和MAGNDATA数据库调查展示其普遍性与潜在的自旋相关功能性。
AI.motivation: 隐藏自旋极化（HSP）在非磁性和共线磁性系统中已被广泛研究，但在非线性磁性材料中仍未被充分探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，建立统一的对称性理论框架来理解和分类非线性磁性材料中的HSP。
AI.method: 基于自旋群理论（spin-group theory）分析非线性磁性材料中的自旋对称性对非相对论自旋极化系统的约束，提出四种自旋纹理分裂类型（SST-1至SST-4），据此结合局部自旋纹理维度和不同局部扇区间的对称关系，将HSP分为三类。采用紧束缚模型验证，并通过第一性原理计算及MAGNDATA数据库筛选候选材料。
AI.result: 建立了统一的对称性框架，将非线性磁体中的HSP分类为HSP-1、HSP-2和HSP-3三种类型；通过多种代表性材料（如SrFe2Se2O、USb、Sr2Mn3Sb2O2、PrFeAsO、GdMn2Si2）加以验证；MAGNDATA数据库调查识别出133个HSP-1、7个HSP-2和139个HSP-3候选材料，且许多材料表现出非零的自旋相关响应张量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为非线性磁性材料中的HSP提供了普适的理论框架，揭示了此类材料在自旋相关功能性器件方面的潜在应用价值，拓展了对隐藏自旋极化的理解范畴。

title: Ultralow p-type contact resistance for ultra-nanoscaled 2D-materials transistors
summary: High contact resistance is one of the main bottlenecks for practical two-dimensional (2D) materials transistors, especially for p-type transistors and future 2D ultra-nanoscaled (sub-10 nm) FETs (PMOS + CMOS). We develop self-consistent contact resistance models for metal-2D semiconductor-metal devices to capture the essential interface physics for both vertical and edge configurations. Our calculations have been verified with various recent experiments of p-type and n-type contacts. For a given set of materials, the model determines the scaling of contact resistance over a wide range of device parameters including channel length (100s nm down to sub-10 nm), doping and mobility of the 2D materials, contact length of the electrodes, and applied voltages. These results identify the key factors in order to reduce the contact resistance for p-type 2D semiconductor WSe$_2$ towards the sub-10 nm channel length scale that are readily to be realized by future experiments. It is found that the effect of source-limited current saturation is the key challenge for down scaling 2D FET to sub-10 nm channel length. Two topological semi-metals as potential electrodes are proposed for 2D p-type semiconducting WSe$_2$ with our predicted contact resistance $R_c<$ 100 $Ω\; {\rm μm}$ approaching the quantum limit. Our model is also verified with the computational expensive full quantum atomistic model that is currently limited to a few nm scale.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了金属-二维半导体-金属器件的自洽接触电阻模型，涵盖垂直和边缘两种接触构型，并通过实验和全量子原子模型验证。模型预测了对WSe₂ p型晶体管在亚10纳米沟道长度下降低接触电阻的关键因素，并提出了两种拓扑半金属电极方案，使接触电阻可低于100 Ω·μm，接近量子极限。
AI.motivation: 高接触电阻是二维材料晶体管实际应用的主要瓶颈，尤其是p型晶体管和亚10纳米尺度的未来2D FET（PMOS+CMOS）。现有超大规模量子计算模型仅限于几纳米尺度，缺乏适用于宽参数范围的接触电阻模型来指导器件设计。
AI.method: 开发自洽接触电阻模型，涵盖金属-2D半导体-金属器件的垂直和边缘两种接触构型；模型参数覆盖沟道长度（100纳米到亚10纳米）、掺杂、迁移率、接触长度和施加电压等；通过与近期p型和n型接触实验及全量子原子模型进行验证。
AI.result: 确定了降低WSe₂ p型半导体接触电阻的关键因素；发现源极限制的电流饱和效应是2D FET缩小到亚10纳米沟道长度的关键挑战；提出两种拓扑半金属电极方案，预测接触电阻Rc<100 Ω·μm，接近量子极限；模型与全量子原子模型验证一致。

title: Autonomous Optimization of Complex Oxides for Thermochemical Fuel Production
summary: Two-step thermochemical fuel production, including H2O and CO2 splitting, offers a promising route to sustainable fuel manufacturing, with performance governed by redox-active oxides that enable cyclic reduction-oxidation reactions. Maximizing thermal-to-fuel conversion efficiency demands materials that simultaneously satisfy multiple stringent thermodynamic and kinetic targets. Addressing these requirements has increasingly driven materials design toward complex, multi-cation oxides, such as mixed-cation fluorites, perovskites, and high-entropy oxides, wherein composition, defect chemistry, phase stability, and morphology should be co-optimized. This creates a challenging materials optimization problem that is poorly suited to traditional trial-and-error approaches. In this review, we argue that thermochemical fuel production provides a compelling frontier for autonomous materials design and optimization. We first examine why redox-active complex oxides are difficult to develop, owing to multidimensional phase spaces, harsh operating conditions, and competing functional targets. We then discuss how high-throughput computation, automated synthesis, characterization and testing, and machine learning can be integrated into closed-loop workflows to address these challenges. Building on broader oxide materials research, we organize recent progress into a capability roadmap for complex-oxide optimization, spanning compositionally diverse synthesis, operando characterization, robotic testing, operation-condition computation, and multi-objective optimization. Finally, we outline key experimental, computational, and data challenges for building self-improving materials development platforms for materials development in thermochemical fuel production.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述性论文，聚焦于两步热化学燃料生产（涉及H2O和CO2分解）中的复杂氧化物材料自主设计与优化。文章论证了热化学燃料生产为自主材料设计提供了一个极具前景的前沿领域，并系统梳理了从高通量计算、自动化合成、表征测试到机器学习集成到闭环工作流中的能力路线图，最后指出了构建自改进材料开发平台所面临的关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 热化学燃料生产是实现可持续燃料制造的有前景途径，但其性能由氧化还原活性氧化物决定。最大化热-燃料转换效率需要材料同时满足多个严苛的热力学和动力学目标，这推动材料设计向复杂多阳离子氧化物（如混合阳离子萤石、钙钛矿和高熵氧化物）方向发展，其中成分、缺陷化学、相稳定性和形貌需要协同优化。这种高维度的材料优化问题极不适合传统试错法，因此需要自主材料设计与优化方法。
AI.method: 本文作为综述性论文，首先分析了氧化还原活性复杂氧化物开发困难的原因（多维相空间、苛刻操作条件、竞争性功能目标）；然后讨论了如何将高通量计算、自动化合成、表征与测试以及机器学习集成到闭环工作流中；进而基于更广泛的氧化物材料研究，构建了复杂氧化物优化的能力路线图，涵盖成分多样化合成、操作态表征、机器人测试、操作条件计算和多目标优化；最后概述了关键的实验、计算和数据挑战。
AI.result: 本文提出了一个面向热化学燃料生产中复杂氧化物优化的系统性能力路线图，将高通量计算、自动化合成、操作态表征、机器人测试和多目标优化等模块整合为闭环工作流，并明确了构建自改进材料开发平台所需的实验、计算和数据方面的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 热化学燃料生产为自主材料设计提供了引人注目的前沿应用场景。通过将实验、计算和数据科学手段在闭环中协同整合，有望实现复杂氧化物的高效自主优化，从而加速可持续燃料制造技术的突破。

title: Beyond the Four-Decade DIIS Default:Auxiliary-Curvature Acceleration of Self-Consistent-Field Calculations
summary: Direct inversion in the iterative subspace (DIIS), introduced in 1980, remains the practical default for accelerating Hartree-Fock and Kohn-Sham self-consistent-field (SCF) calculations. Many later methods improve robustness or iteration count, but the near-zero overhead of DIIS makes a broad reduction in total wall time difficult. We introduce AURORA-SCF (auxiliary-curvature unified Riemannian orbital-response acceleration), which evaluates energy and gradient only with the requested target Hamiltonian while obtaining most orbital curvature from an independent valence-STO-3G model. A target-level, transported L-BFGS history corrects the model mismatch; a shifted matrix-free solve, trust region, and geodesic orbital update control the step. In 16 direct CPU RHF pairs spanning 137-1484 atomic orbitals, AURORA-SCF was faster in every case, reducing mean wall time by 26.2% and target J/K builds by 33.3%. In a separate set of 63 converged, energy-matched density-fitted GPU pairs spanning seven molecules, closed- and open-shell formalisms, and HF, PBE, B3LYP, and M06-2X, it was again faster in every included pair, with mean reductions of 26.5% in wall time and 31.9% in target J/K builds. Focused direct CPU and GPU sweeps show mean wall-time reductions of 30-34%. These results establish a specific advance beyond the four-decade DIIS default: transferred, secant-corrected curvature can reduce total SCF wall time, not merely iteration count, without changing the target stationary equations. The same optimization pattern also suggests a route to faster orbital optimization elsewhere in quantum chemistry and to multifidelity optimization across scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AURORA-SCF，一种新型SCF加速方法，通过独立价层STO-3G模型获取大部分轨道曲率，结合目标级别的L-BFGS历史校正、移位矩阵自由求解、信赖域和测地线轨道更新，在16个直接CPU RHF和63个密度拟合GPU算例中均实现更快收敛，平均减少墙钟时间26-34%，超越DIIS四十年来的默认地位。
AI.motivation: DIIS自1980年提出以来一直是SCF计算加速的实际默认方法，虽然后续方法在鲁棒性或迭代次数上有所改进，但DIIS接近零的开销使得在总墙钟时间上实现大幅缩减非常困难，需要一种能真正减少总计算时间而非仅减少迭代次数的新方法。
AI.method: AURORA-SCF采用辅助曲率统一黎曼轨道响应加速框架：仅用目标哈密顿量计算能量和梯度，通过独立的价层STO-3G模型获取大部分轨道曲率；使用目标级别的传输L-BFGS历史来校正模型不匹配；结合移位矩阵自由求解、信赖域和测地线轨道更新来控制步长。
AI.result: 在16个直接CPU RHF算例（137-1484个原子轨道）中，所有情况均更快，平均墙钟时间减少26.2%，目标J/K构建减少33.3%；在63个能量匹配的密度拟合GPU算例中（覆盖闭合/开放壳层，HF/PBE/B3LYP/M06-2X），平均墙钟时间减少26.5%，目标J/K构建减少31.9%；聚焦的CPU和GPU扫描显示平均墙钟时间减少30-34%。
AI.conclusion: AURORA-SCF证明传输的割线校正曲率可以真正减少SCF总墙钟时间而不仅仅是迭代次数，且不改变目标稳态方程，是对DIIS四十年来默认地位的实质性突破；该优化模式也为量子化学中其他轨道优化和科学计算中的多保真度优化提供了新路径。

title: Spin Qubits in Photon-Coupled Microwave Cavities
summary: Electron spin qubits in microwave cavities provide a promising platform for scalable quantum computing hardware, leveraging long coherence times, charge-noise robustness and cavity mediated qubit-qubit interactions. While the strong spin-photon coupling regime is accessible via on-chip micromagnets, scaling conventional architectures by placing multiple qubits within a single shared resonator degrades transmission amplitudes, hence limiting large-scale efficiency. To overcome this limitation, we analyze a modular architecture where individual cavities containing a limited number of qubits are coupled via single-photon-exchange waveguides. Using input/output theory, we compute the transmission amplitudes for networks of two and three coupled cavities in various configurations. We map out the distinct physical regimes accessible by tuning key system parameters, offering a viable pathway for scalable cavity-based quantum spin qubit networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化的微波腔量子自旋量子比特架构，通过单光子交换波导将包含少量量子比特的独立腔体耦合起来，避免了传统共享谐振腔架构中因放置多个量子比特而导致的传输幅度退化问题，为可扩展的腔量子自旋网络提供了可行路径。
AI.motivation: 电子自旋量子比特在微波腔中具有长相干时间和抗电荷噪声等优势，但传统共享谐振腔架构中放置多个量子比特会降低传输幅度，限制大规模扩展效率。
AI.method: 利用输入输出理论计算两个和三个耦合腔体在不同配置下的传输幅度，通过调节关键系统参数绘制出可达到的不同物理区域。
AI.result: 分析了双腔和三腔耦合网络的传输特性，映射出通过调节系统参数可访问的不同物理区域，验证了模块化架构的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 模块化腔体通过波导耦合架构能够克服传统共享谐振腔的扩展限制，为可扩展的腔基量子自旋量子比特网络提供了可行方案。

title: Local Structure Dictates Ionic Transport and Mechanical Properties in Glassy Solid Electrolytes for Lithium Batteries
summary: Electrolytes composed of sulfide and halide glasses are promising candidates for all-solid-state lithium batteries owing to their processability, lack of grain boundaries, and relatively high ionic conductivity. Nevertheless, their ionic conductivity and mechanical properties are still not satisfying for the real-world applications. Significant advances in solid electrolytes require a thorough understanding of their microstructures. Here, we reveal the connections among structure, ionic transport properties, and mechanical stability in a series of glassy solid electrolytes by employing molecular dynamics simulations based on a machine learning interatomic potential. Specifically, we explore how the interplay between B-S and P-S networks in glassy Li-S-P-B-I (LSPBI) governs ionic conductivity and deformation behavior. The introduction of P2S5 into a B2S3-based glass induces a critical structural transformation, through which both ionic conductivity and mechanical nano-ductility can be enhanced. For a moderate P2S5 content, incorporated PS4 units depolymerize the rigid boron framework, creating percolative diffusion pathways for fast ionic transport. Concurrently, the flexible P-S-P configurations enable energy dissipation through bond bending, leading to the brittle-to-ductile transition. However, excessive P2S5 increases the fraction of polyphosphates (e.g., P2S6 and P2S7), thereby polymerizing the structural network and ultimately impeding Li+ mobility. Our work thus provides atomistic principles for engineering glass electrolytes with balanced ionic conductivity and mechanical robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文利用基于机器学习原子间势能的分子动力学模拟，揭示了玻璃态Li-S-P-B-I（LSPBI）固体电解质中B-S与P-S网络结构、离子输运性能和力学稳定性之间的关联，发现适量P2S5引入可同时增强离子电导率和纳米延展性，而过量P2S5则因多磷酸盐聚合而阻碍锂离子迁移。
AI.motivation: 硫化物和卤化物玻璃态电解质在全固态锂电池中具有良好前景，但其离子电导率和力学性能仍不满足实际应用需求。深入了解其微观结构是实现突破的关键。
AI.method: 采用基于机器学习原子间势能的分子动力学模拟，系统研究一系列玻璃态固体电解质，重点分析P2S5含量变化对LSPBI玻璃中B-S与P-S网络相互作用的影响。
AI.result: 适量P2S5可使PS4单元解聚刚性硼框架，形成渗透扩散通道促进锂离子传输；同时柔性P-S-P构型通过键弯曲耗散能量，实现脆性到延性转变。但过量P2S5会形成P2S6和P2S7等多磷酸盐，使结构网络聚合化，最终阻碍Li+迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为设计兼具高离子电导率和优异力学性能的玻璃态电解质提供了原子层面的设计原则。

title: The origin of carotenoid triplets in purple photosynthetic bacteria
summary: Photosynthetic antenna proteins harvest light energy while at the same time protecting the organism against photodamage. Carotenoid molecules are essential in the latter process, efficiently quenching unwanted (bacterio)chlorophyll excited states created after photon absorption. (Bacterio)chlorophyll triplets, formed by inter-system crossing, are particularly significant, since in the absence of carotenoid quenching, they sensitise the highly oxidative singlet oxygen. In light-harvesting complex 2 (LH2) from Rhodoblastus acidophilus, the pathways that populate carotenoid dark and triplet states remain controversial, involving bacteriochlorophyll-to-carotenoid triplet-triplet transfer and/or generation of triplets by the carotenoid molecules themselves through singlet fission. Transient absorption has been central to understanding photoprotection in these organisms, but spectral congestion limits the separation of the overlapping species needed to discriminate between these pathways. By applying femtosecond stimulated resonance Raman spectroscopy (FSRRS) in different resonance conditions to this protein, in combination with an extension of global analysis to four dimensions (wavenumber, time, intensity and resonance condition), we separate each component of the carotenoid dark-state manifold together with its kinetics. An entangled triplet pair S*/1(TT) is observed, which lives about 60 ps, some eight times longer than in solution. However, this stabilisation does not open a pathway to separated triplets or to carotenoid-BChl a heterofission. Triplet-triplet transfer from bacteriochlorophyll a to carotenoid is also resolved under BChl a excitation, and fits cleanly as a single 2100 ps component. The carotenoid triplet in LH2 is thus produced by photoprotective triplet-triplet transfer from BChl a, and not by singlet fission.

AI.tldr: 本文利用飞秒受激共振拉曼光谱（FSRRS）结合四维全局分析（波数、时间、强度、共振条件），分离了Rhodoblastus acidophilus的LH2捕光复合物中类胡萝卜素暗态流形的各组分及其动力学。发现缠结三重态对S*/1(TT)寿命约60 ps，比溶液中长约8倍，但并未开启分离三重态或杂化裂变通路；而BChl a到类胡萝卜素的三重态-三重态转移以单一2100 ps组分清晰拟合。结论：LH2中类胡萝卜素三重态由光保护性三重态转移产生，而非单线态裂变。
AI.motivation: 光合天线蛋白需要兼顾光能采集与光保护，类胡萝卜素通过淬灭（细菌）叶绿素激发态来防止单线态氧损伤。在Rhodoblastus acidophilus的LH2复合物中，类胡萝卜素暗态和三重态的通路存在争议——究竟是通过BChl到类胡萝卜素的三重态-三重态转移，还是类胡萝卜素自身通过单线态裂变产生三重态。传统的瞬态吸收光谱因谱峰重叠而难以区分这些重叠物种，因此需要更高分辨率的谱学方法来分辨这些通路。
AI.method: 采用飞秒受激共振拉曼光谱（FSRRS）在不同共振条件下测量LH2蛋白，并将全局分析扩展到四维（波数、时间、强度、共振条件），从而将类胡萝卜素暗态流形中的每个组分及其动力学分离开来。
AI.result: 观察到缠结三重态对S*/1(TT)，寿命约60 ps，约为溶液中的8倍。但这种稳定化并未开启通向分离三重态或类胡萝卜素-BChl a杂化裂变的通路。在BChl a激发下，解析出BChl a到类胡萝卜素的三重态-三重态转移，以单一2100 ps组分清晰拟合。
AI.conclusion: LH2中类胡萝卜素三重态是由BChl a的光保护性三重态-三重态转移产生的，而非通过单线态裂变产生。这澄清了长期存在争议的LH2光保护机制。

title: Out-of-equilibrium spin-valley dynamics of ferromagnets in topological Chern bands
comment: Main text: 6 pages, 4 figures; Methods: 8 pages (+ 14 extended data figures)
summary: Understanding quantum matter far from equilibrium is a central goal of modern physics. Twisted MoTe2 bilayers constitute a promising platform for exploring this frontier by combining strong Coulomb interactions, nontrivial band geometry, and optical control. Here, we exploit this setting to investigate the role of topology and many-body correlations in the out-of-equilibrium dynamics of ferromagnets in Chern bands. Using a focused circularly polarized light pulse, we create a local magnetic domain oriented opposite to an external magnetic field and directly image its subsequent spin-valley relaxation in spatially and time-resolved low-temperature experiments. We demonstrate that in the vicinity of both integer and fractional Chern insulating states, the dynamics is governed by qualitatively different mechanisms than in ferromagnetic metals. Whereas metallic domains collapse by shrinking, Chern domains melt via thermal activation, resulting in drastically different temporal spin evolution and orders-of-magnitude longer relaxation times. These findings demonstrate the influence of topology and strong correlations on far-from-equilibrium collective spin phases, opening new opportunities for dynamical control of ferromagnets in the quantum Hall regime.

AI.tldr: 本文通过空间和时间分辨的低温实验，在扭曲MoTe2双层中利用圆偏振光脉冲创建局域磁畴，研究了Chern带中铁磁体远离平衡态的自旋-谷弛豫动力学，发现整数量子化的Chern绝缘体附近磁畴通过热激活熔化而非金属中常见的收缩塌陷，且弛豫时间长数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 理解量子物质远离平衡态的动力学是现代物理学的核心目标，而扭曲MoTe2双层结合了强库仑相互作用、非平庸带几何和光学调控等优势，是探索该前沿的理想平台。现有研究缺乏对Chern带中拓扑和强关联效应对非平衡自旋集体相动力学影响的深入理解。
AI.method: 使用聚焦圆偏振光脉冲在扭曲MoTe2双层中创建与外磁场方向相反的局域磁畴（自旋-谷翻转），并通过空间和时间分辨的低温实验直接成像随后的自旋-谷弛豫过程，对比整数和分数量子化的Chern绝缘体态与铁磁金属中磁畴的动力学行为。
AI.result: 发现Chern绝缘体态附近磁畴通过热激活熔化机制弛豫，不同于铁磁金属中磁畴通过收缩塌陷的方式；两者在时间自旋演化和弛豫时间上有质的区别，Chern域弛豫时间比金属域长数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 证明拓扑和强关联效应对Chern带中远离平衡态的集体自旋相有深远影响，为量子霍尔体系中铁磁体的动力学控制开辟了新途径。

title: Fast Isotropic Li-Ion Diffusion in Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework Glass Electrolytes for Batteries
summary: All-solid-state lithium batteries require solid electrolytes that combine rapid room-temperature ion transport with mechanical robustness and interfacial compatibility. Zeolitic imidazolate framework (ZIF) glasses, with ZIFs being a sub-set of metal-organic frameworks, offer an attractive yet relatively underexplored platform because they combine an grainboundary-free and amorphous topology with chemically tunable frameworks. Here, we reveal that structural disorder unlocks fast and isotropic lithium diffusion in ZIF glasses. This is realized by using a machine learning interatomic potential to simulate Li+ transport in crystalline and glassy ZIF-4 and ZIF-62. Structural disorder reduces the activation energy for Li+ migration from ~0.35 eV to 0.16 eV and increases the extrapolated room-temperature diffusion coefficient by more than one order of magnitude for ZIF-4 and nearly sevenfold for ZIF-62. Analyses of non-Gaussian dynamics and van Hove correlation functions reveal that Li+ diffusion in crystalline ZIFs occurs via rare, dynamically heterogeneous hopping events among well-defined cages, whereas Li+ diffusion in glassy ZIFs is more homogeneous, continuous, and Fickian-like, benefiting from a wide distribution of coordination geometries and migration barriers. Li+ diffusion in crystalline ZIFs is strongly anisotropic, reflecting that ordered orientations of imidazolate and benzimidazolate rings impose distinct energy barriers along different crystallographic directions. Upon vitrification, these ring orientations become randomized, and hence, the diffusion of Li+ becomes isotropic or near-isotropic. These findings imply that well-designed metal-organic framework glasses are a promising candidate as high-performance solid-state electrolytes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习原子间势模拟，揭示了ZIF（沸石咪唑酯骨架）玻璃中结构无序性可解锁快速且各向同性的锂离子扩散。无序降低了Li+迁移活化能（从~0.35 eV降至0.16 eV），使室温扩散系数提高一个数量级以上，并实现了从各向异性到各向同性扩散的转变，表明MOF玻璃是极具前景的固态电解质候选材料。
AI.motivation: 全固态锂电池需要兼具快速室温离子传输、机械稳健性和界面相容性的固态电解质。ZIF玻璃作为金属有机框架（MOF）的子类，结合了无晶界无定形拓扑与化学可调框架，但作为锂离子导体尚未被充分探索，因此本文旨在揭示结构无序对锂离子传输的影响。
AI.method: 采用机器学习原子间势（machine learning interatomic potential）对结晶态和玻璃态ZIF-4及ZIF-62中的Li+传输进行分子动力学模拟；通过分析非高斯动力学、van Hove相关函数、活化能计算及各向异性扩散系数来系统地比较晶态与玻璃态中的扩散机制。
AI.result: 结构无序将Li+迁移活化能从0.35 eV降低至0.16 eV；ZIF-4的室温扩散系数提升超一个数量级，ZIF-62提升近7倍。晶态中Li+扩散具有强各向异性，通过罕见且动态异质的跳跃事件发生；玻璃态中扩散更均匀、连续、接近Fickian扩散，且变为各向同性或近各向同性。
AI.conclusion: ZIF玻璃中的结构无序从根本上改变了锂离子的扩散机制——从晶态中受限、异质、各向异性的跳跃式传输转变为玻璃态中连续、均匀、各向同性的扩散——这表明精心设计的MOF玻璃是高性能固态电解质的有力候选材料。

title: Homojunction-induced thermopower enhancement in polymer films
summary: It has been more than twenty years since conductive polymers began to receive attention as an emerging thermoelectric material. However, the trade-off between electrical conductivity (σ) and thermopower (S) has proven to be a major challenge that has obstructed their use in actual devices. Here we report the discovery that the thermopower of the p- and n-type legs of organic thermogenerators can be substantially enhanced, without significant deterioration of σ, by constructing an in-plane segmented structure consisting of a homojunction with different doping levels on either side. In such segmented layers, the S is abnormally higher than the average value of the constituent parts when applying a forward temperature gradient (heating the heavily doped counterpart), while it is lower upon a reverse temperature gradient. Typically, for a two-stage segmented film of p-type PDPP-Se, an abnormally large S of 210 uV K-1 and σ of 2.5*10^4 S m-1 are obtained, resulting in a large power factor (PF) of 1100 uW m-1 K-2 and a record ZT of 1.36 at room temperature. The enhanced thermopower is attributed to an additional voltage developed at the homojunction under heating as explained by kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. This finding provides a breakthrough approach to the modulation of thermoelectric transport properties of conductive polymers.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种通过构建具有不同掺杂水平的同质结平面分段结构，同时提升有机热电材料塞贝克系数(S)而不显著降低电导率(σ)的方法。通过在p型和n型有机热电腿中应用该结构，实现了异常高的S值。以p型PDPP-Se的两段式分段薄膜为例，获得了210 uV K⁻¹的S、2.5×10⁴ S m⁻¹的σ，以及1100 uW m⁻¹ K⁻²的功率因子和室温下创纪录的1.36的ZT值。
AI.motivation: 导电聚合物作为新兴热电材料已研究二十余年，但电导率(σ)与塞贝克系数(S)之间的权衡关系一直是阻碍其实际器件应用的主要挑战。作者旨在打破这一限制，寻找同时提升σ和S的方法。
AI.method: 作者构建了由不同掺杂水平组成的同质结平面分段结构。当施加正向温度梯度（加热重掺杂一侧）时，S异常高于各组成部分的平均值；而反向温度梯度时S则降低。通过动力学蒙特卡洛模拟解释了同质结在加热条件下产生的额外电压导致了塞贝克系数的增强。
AI.result: 对于p型PDPP-Se的两段式分段薄膜，获得了异常大的S值210 uV K⁻¹和σ为2.5×10⁴ S m⁻¹，得到大功率因子1100 uW m⁻¹ K⁻²，以及室温下创纪录的ZT值1.36。
AI.conclusion: 这一发现为导电聚合物热电传输性质的调控提供了突破性方法，通过同质结分段结构有效解决了σ与S之间的权衡难题，为有机热电材料的实际器件应用开辟了新途径。

title: Magneto-optical signal from $\mathrm{Co_2Mn}$-based Heusler thin films in MOKE and BLS
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Data available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21323893
summary: $\mathrm{Co_2Mn}$-based Heusler compounds offer a versatile, composition-tunable platform for magnonics and spintronics. Among them, the half-metallic $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$ is of particular interest for magnonics owing to its ultralow Gilbert damping, yet its weak magneto-optical response in the visible challenges optical probing such as Brillouin light scattering (BLS). We study the magneto-optical response of epitaxial $\mathrm{Co_2Mn}X$ films ($X = \{\mathrm{Al}_x\mathrm{Si}_{1-x}, \mathrm{Ga}_x\mathrm{Ge}_{1-x}, \mathrm{Sn}\}$) by magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) spectroscopy and BLS. Angle-resolved MOKE resolves a significant, wavelength-dependent quadratic MOKE (QMOKE) only for $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$, whereas $\mathrm{Co_2MnAl}$, $\mathrm{Co_2MnGa}$ and $\mathrm{Co_2MnSn}$ respond dominantly linearly. Comparing BLS intensities of thermal magnons at two wavelengths, $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$ gives the weakest signal at $532\,\mathrm{nm}$ yet among the strongest at $457\,\mathrm{nm}$, tracking the spectral dependence of its Kerr angle. These results emphasise the relation between the two magneto-optical techniques, guiding the choice of probing wavelength for $\mathrm{Co_2Mn}$-based Heusler compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了外延生长的Co₂MnX（X = {AlₓSi₁₋ₓ, GaₓGe₁₋ₓ, Sn}）Heusler合金薄膜的磁光响应。通过MOKE光谱和BLS测量发现，Co₂MnSi在可见光区具有显著的波长依赖的二次磁光Kerr效应（QMOKE），而其他合金主要呈现线性响应。BLS强度与Kerr角的光谱依赖一致：Co₂MnSi在532 nm处信号最弱，但在457 nm处却是最强之一，为选择Co₂Mn基Heusler化合物的探测波长提供了指导。
AI.motivation: Co₂MnSi具有超低Gilbert阻尼，是磁子学研究的理想材料，但其在可见光区域的弱磁光响应给BLS等光学探测手段带来了挑战。理解其磁光响应机制并找到合适的探测波长，对于该材料在磁子学中的应用至关重要。
AI.method: 对一系列外延Co₂MnX薄膜（X = {AlₓSi₁₋ₓ, GaₓGe₁₋ₓ, Sn}）进行MOKE光谱测量与角度分辨QMOKE分析，同时在不同波长（532 nm和457 nm）下测量热磁子的BLS强度，并对比不同组分薄膜的磁光响应特征。
AI.result: 角度分辨MOKE显示仅Co₂MnSi表现出显著的、波长依赖的QMOKE，而Co₂MnAl、Co₂MnGa和Co₂MnSn主要呈线性Kerr响应。BLS实验证实Co₂MnSi在532 nm处信号最弱，但在457 nm处信号最强之一，BLS强度与Kerr角的光谱依赖直接相关。
AI.conclusion: MOKE与BLS两种磁光技术之间存在密切关联，Kerr角的光谱依赖性直接决定了BLS信号强度。对于Co₂Mn基Heusler化合物，选择457 nm等短波长探测可显著增强Co₂MnSi的BLS信号，为该材料体系的磁子学光学研究提供了明确的波长选择依据。

title: Spin-group theory on Edelstein effect and spin-orbit torque in Collinear Ferromagnets
summary: Current-induced spin-orbit torques (SOTs) are central to the electrical manipulation of magnetic order in spintronic devices. In transition-metal/collinear ferromagnet bilayers, field-like and damping-like torques have been described only phenomenologically via the spin or orbital Hall effect, lacking a rigorous symmetry-based foundation. The precise role of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in both the Edelstein effect and SOTs has remained unresolved. Here we develop a spin-group symmetry theory for the Edelstein effect and SOTs in collinear ferromagnets, treating SOC as a symmetry-breaking perturbation. For 4mm (C4v) point group symmetry, we derive the full forms of field-like and damping-like torques, which arise predominantly from first- and second-order SOC. We further show that SOTs in both orbital-Hall-dominated Ti/Ni and spin-Hall-dominated Pt/CoFe bilayers originate at first-order SOC. Taking the 3m (C3v) torque as a paradigmatic example, we elucidate the role of second- and higher-order SOC torques in field-free switching of perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Remarkably, in PtMnSb, we demonstrate that SOTs under certain point group symmetries deviate from the conventional form: zeroth- and first-order SOC contributions vanish identically, with the leading SOT emerging at second order. All symmetry-based predictions from spin-group theory are in excellent quantitative agreement with first-principles calculations. Our work establishes a unified symmetry framework for the microscopic understanding of the Edelstein effect and current-induced spin torques in ferromagnetic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了自旋群对称性理论，系统地阐述了共线铁磁体中Edelstein效应和自旋轨道转矩（SOTs）的微观起源，将SOC视为对称性破缺微扰，并从第一性原理计算验证了所有对称性预测。
AI.motivation: 传统上，过渡金属/共线铁磁体双层中的场类似和阻尼类似转矩只能通过自旋或轨道霍尔效应的唯象描述，缺乏严格的基于对称性的理论基础。SOC在Edelstein效应和SOTs中的精确作用一直未得到解决。
AI.method: 作者开发了用于共线铁磁体中Edelstein效应和SOTs的自旋群对称性理论，将SOC作为对称性破缺微扰处理。推导了4mm（C4v）点群下场类似和阻尼类似转矩的完整形式，并分析了不同点群对称性下的SOC阶次贡献。
AI.result: 4mm点群下场类似和阻尼类似转矩分别主要来源于一阶和二阶SOC。Ti/Ni和Pt/CoFe双层中的SOTs均起源于一阶SOC。在PtMnSb中，某些点群对称性下SOTs偏离传统形式：零阶和一阶SOC贡献消失，主导SOT出现在二阶。所有预测与第一性原理计算定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了统一的对称性框架，用于微观理解铁磁系统中的Edelstein效应和电流诱导自旋转矩，为SOTs的物理解释提供了严格的对称性基础。

title: Topological surface altermagnets in SSH-stacked magnetic layers
summary: Surface altermagnetism opens new avenues in spintronics by unlocking altermagnetic spin-splitting at the boundaries of conventional antiferromagnets, bypassing the strict symmetry requirements of bulk altermagnets. In this work, we propose creating topological surface altermagnet by stacking magnetic layers in a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger pattern. We show that while the bulk of the system is a standard antiferromagnet with degenerate bands protected by $PT$ symmetry, breaking the local symmetry at the boundary gives rise to a topologically protected surface altermagnetic state residing within the topological gap. Furthermore, we propose that this effect can be experimentally detected by applying a perpendicular electric field. Besides, this approach can be readily generalized to surface altermagnetism of different types. Our work establishes topological boundaries as a natural platform for surface altermagnetism, offering a distinct route for realizing and manipulating topological surface altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过在Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模式下堆叠磁性层，在传统反铁磁体的边界处创造拓扑表面交变磁体。系统体态是受PT对称性保护的标准反铁磁体，但边界处局域对称性破缺会产生拓扑保护的表面交变磁态，可通过垂直电场进行实验探测。
AI.motivation: 表面交变磁性为自旋电子学开辟了新途径，可在传统反铁磁体边界实现交变磁自旋劈裂，绕过了体交变磁体严格的对称性要求。研究者希望探索一种新的机制，在拓扑边界这一自然平台上实现并调控表面交变磁体。
AI.method: 采用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模式堆叠磁性层来构建体系。利用PT对称性保护体态简并带，通过在边界打破局域对称性来产生拓扑保护的表面交变磁态，并提出施加垂直电场进行实验探测的方案。
AI.result: 研究表明体系体态为标准反铁磁体（具有PT对称性保护的简并带），而边界处对称性破缺可产生位于拓扑隙内的拓扑保护表面交变磁态；该效应可通过垂直电场实验检测，且方法可推广到不同类型的表面交变磁性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了拓扑边界作为表面交变磁性的自然平台，为实现和操控拓扑表面交变磁体提供了独特路径。

title: Local lattice dynamics of hcp zinc from EXAFS and machine-learning interatomic potentials
summary: The lattice dynamics of hexagonal close-packed (hcp) zinc, a prototypical anisotropic metal, is studied using temperature-dependent Zn K-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectroscopy combined with atomistic simulations. The reverse Monte Carlo method enable the extraction of mean-square relative displacements (MSRDs) for eight coordination shells, providing a shell-resolved description of thermal motion. The MSRD temperature dependence, analysed using the correlated Einstein model, yields effective interatomic force constants and reveals pronounced anisotropy between in-plane and out-of-plane interactions. This anisotropy is further quantified by the ratio of MSRDs for the first and second coordination shells, which closely matches the anisotropic displacement parameters from diffraction experiments. Molecular dynamics simulations using the CHGNet universal machine-learning interatomic potential show that the original model overestimates thermal disorder, while a fine-tuned version substantially improves agreement with experimental EXAFS spectrum and radial distribution function. Overall, EXAFS-informed analysis is effective for validating and refining machine-learning interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合温度依赖的Zn K-edge EXAFS光谱与原子模拟，系统研究了六方密堆积（hcp）锌的各向异性晶格动力学。通过逆蒙特卡洛方法提取了八个配位壳层的均方相对位移（MSRDs），并使用相关爱因斯坦模型分析其温度依赖性，获得了有效原子间力常数并揭示了面内与面外相互作用的明显各向异性。分子动力学模拟表明，原始的CHGNet通用机器学习原子间势会高估热无序，而微调后的版本能显著改善与实验EXAFS谱和径向分布函数的一致性。研究表明EXAFS分析是验证和优化机器学习原子间势的有效工具。
AI.motivation: 锌作为典型的各向异性金属，其晶格动力学行为（特别是面内与面外相互作用的差异）尚需深入理解。同时，机器学习原子间势的验证需要可靠的实验参照，EXAFS作为一种对局部结构和热振动敏感的探测手段，可用于评估和优化这些势函数。
AI.method: 1) 温度依赖性Zn K-edge EXAFS光谱实验；2) 逆蒙特卡洛（RMC）方法提取八个配位壳层的MSRDs；3) 相关爱因斯坦模型分析MSRD温度依赖性，导出有效力常数；4) 使用CHGNet通用机器学习原子间势进行分子动力学模拟，并对原始模型进行微调（fine-tuning）以提高与实验的吻合度。
AI.result: 获得了八个配位壳层的壳层分辨热运动描述；揭示了hcp锌面内与面外相互作用的显著各向异性，第一、第二配位壳层MSRD之比与衍射实验的各向异性位移参数高度吻合；发现原始CHGNet模型高估热无序，微调版本显著改善了与实验EXAFS谱及径向分布函数的一致性。
AI.conclusion: EXAFS信息分析是验证和优化机器学习原子间势的有效手段，能够为机器学习势函数的精细调优提供关键的实验约束，从而提高模拟的可靠性。

title: Perfect absorption by metal-contacted two-dimensional systems with ultra-proximate reflectors
summary: Electromagnetic absorbance by most two-dimensional electron systems is typically well below unity, which hinders both practical applications in photodetection and fundamental studies of their optical properties. Here, we show that a periodic structure comprised of narrow two-dimensional sections connected with wide perfectly conducting metal sections enables large absorbance. It reaches 50 \% provided the filling factor by the two-dimensional system $f$ equals its dimensionless conductivity $η=σZ_0/2$, where $Z_0$ is the free-space impedance. The absorbance is further raised to 100 \% if the periodic structure is placed above a perfectly conducting electromagnetic reflector, and provided $f=2η$. Surprisingly, the optimal distance between two-dimensional system and reflector may fall well below the quarter of incident wavelength $λ_0/4$, which was assumed as conventional absorption enhancement condition in optics. For low filling factors $f\ll1$, large dielectric constants of the substrate, and grating periods comparable with $λ_0$, the optimal distance to reflector tends to zero. Above the critical values of the grating geometrical parameters, the absorbance maximum ceases to exist. The critical behavior manifests as a large-amplitude resonance in 'dirty' two-dimensional system with purely real conductivity, while enhancement of carrier momentum relaxation time lowers the resonant peak. Such resonance mimics the plasmonic one, but does not rely on high electron mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了由窄二维电子系统段与宽完美导电金属段构成的周期结构可以实现高达50%的电磁吸收率，当将该结构置于完美导电反射器上方时吸收率可进一步提升至100%。关键在于二维系统的填充因子与其无量纲电导率满足特定关系，且最优距离可以远低于传统认为的λ₀/4条件。
AI.motivation: 大多数二维电子系统的电磁吸收率通常远低于1，这阻碍了它们在光电探测等实际应用以及基础光学性质研究中的发展。作者希望找到一种结构设计，能够大幅提升二维电子系统的吸收率。
AI.method: 采用周期结构设计，将窄的二维电子段与宽的完美导电金属段交替连接。通过调控二维系统的填充因子f与无量纲电导率η的关系（f=η时吸收50%，f=2η且置于反射器上方时吸收100%）来实现增强吸收。研究了该结构与完美导电反射器的最佳距离、基片介电常数及光栅周期等参数的影响。
AI.result: 吸收率可达50%（f=η），加反射器后可提升至100%（f=2η）。最优距离可远低于λ₀/4，在低填充因子、大介电常数基片和光栅周期接近λ₀时，最优距离趋于零。超过临界几何参数时吸收最大值消失，临界行为表现为类等离子体共振，但不依赖高电子迁移率。
AI.conclusion: 该周期结构能够显著增强二维电子系统的电磁吸收率，突破了传统λ₀/4吸收增强条件的限制，所展现的类等离子体共振不依赖于高电子迁移率，为光电探测和光学研究提供了新途径。

title: Net and Hidden Spin-Valley Locking Enable Ultrahigh Hole Mobility in Covalent Bulk WN$_2$
summary: High carrier mobility at room temperature underpins high-performance electronics, yet high hole mobility remains rare in bulk semiconductors. Spin-valley locking can suppress intervalley scattering and enhance mobility, but it is limited to materials with broken inversion symmetry. Hidden spin polarization offers a possible route beyond this constraint, although whether its compensated spin textures could protect charge transport remains unclear. Using ab initio electron-phonon and transport calculations, we show that the two hexagonal phases of bulk WN$_2$ realize net and hidden spin-valley locking and exhibit ultrahigh room-temperature hole mobilities. In non-centrosymmetric $α$-WN$_2$, a large valley spin splitting produces net spin-valley locking that nearly eliminates phonon-mediated intervalley scattering. In centrosymmetric $β$-WN$_2$, hidden Zeeman-type spin polarization yields a compensated, sector-resolved spin texture that reverses between valleys and suppresses intervalley scattering as effectively as the net locking does. The stiff W-N/N-N covalent network further keeps the remaining intravalley scattering weak. Our results establish hidden spin polarization as an effective transport-protection mechanism and extend spin-valley engineering to centrosymmetric bulk semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 通过从头算电子-声子与输运计算，本文证明体相WN₂的两种六方相分别实现净自旋-谷锁定（非中心对称α相）和隐藏自旋-谷锁定（中心对称β相），均表现出极高的室温空穴迁移率，揭示了隐藏自旋极化可作为有效的输运保护机制，将自旋-谷工程扩展到中心对称体相半导体。
AI.motivation: 高室温空穴迁移率在体相半导体中十分稀有；自旋-谷锁定虽能抑制谷间散射提升迁移率，但受限于破缺反演对称性的材料。隐藏自旋极化或可突破此限制，但其补偿型自旋织构能否保护电荷输运仍不清楚。
AI.method: 采用从头算电子-声子相互作用和输运计算方法，系统研究体相WN₂的两种六方相（α与β）中自旋-谷锁定与空穴迁移率的关系，对比净自旋锁定与非中心对称相的隐藏Zeeman型自旋极化的输运保护效果。
AI.result: α-WN₂中大的谷自旋劈裂产生净自旋-谷锁定，几乎完全消除声子介导的谷间散射；β-WN₂中隐藏Zeeman型自旋极化产生补偿的、按扇区分辨的自旋织构，在谷间反向翻转，抑制谷间散射的效果与净锁定相当。同时，刚性的W-N/N-N共价网络使残余的谷内散射保持较弱，最终两种相均实现超高室温空穴迁移率。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏自旋极化是一种有效的输运保护机制，自旋-谷工程可推广至中心对称体相半导体，为设计高迁移率材料提供了新路径。

title: Exciton Alchemy: Chern Excitons from Trivial Bands
summary: Exciton topology is commonly inherited from the topology of the underlying electronic bands. Recent theoretical work, however, has shown that the exciton Chern number can in general receive an additional contribution from the topology of the exciton envelope wave function, allowing, in principle, interaction-induced topological excitons even when the constituent electronic bands are topologically trivial. Here, we provide an explicit realization of this case by constructing a two-dimensional exciton model with topologically trivial conduction and valence bands that nevertheless hosts a Chern exciton diagnosed by inversion symmetry. Starting from a real-space limit of exponentially localized Wannier states for the conduction and valence bands, we identify the essential ingredients responsible for the emergent exciton topology and formulate a simple construction recipe. Our work demonstrates that interactions alone can generate nontrivial exciton topology, independent of the topology of the underlying electronic bands, and establishes a general framework for designing interaction-induced topological excitons.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构造一个导带和价带均拓扑平庸的二维激子模型，显式实现了仅有相互作用诱导的拓扑激子（Chern激子），证明激子的拓扑可以在不依赖于底层电子带拓扑的情况下产生。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为激子拓扑继承自底层电子带的拓扑。然而近期理论工作表明，激子Chern数还可能从激子包络波函数的拓扑中获得额外贡献，因此原则上可以存在交互诱导的拓扑激子，即使组成激子的电子带是拓扑平庸的。本文旨在提供一个该情形的显式实现，并阐明其产生机制。
AI.method: 构造一个二维激子模型，其中导带和价带均用指数局域的Wannier态（实空间极限）表示，且都是拓扑平庸的。通过分析激子包络波函数的拓扑性质（由反演对称性判定Chern数），识别出产生涌现激子拓扑的关键要素，并给出简单的构造配方。
AI.result: 成功实现了具有拓扑平庸导带和价带却仍承载Chern激子的二维模型，该激子的拓扑由反演对称性诊断。证明了相互作用单独即可产生非平凡的激子拓扑，与底层电子带拓扑无关。
AI.conclusion: 本文工作首次显式证明了仅靠相互作用就能产生非平凡的激子拓扑，建立了设计相互作用诱导拓扑激子的一般框架，为探索不依赖电子带拓扑的新型拓扑物态提供了理论依据。

title: Morphology Engineering of Mixed Ionic Electronic Conductors through Aqueous Phase Separation
comment: conducting polymer, PEDOT:PSS, porous films, organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs), ion sensing
summary: The performance of organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs) is fundamentally governed by the interplay between ionic accessibility and electronic transport within organic mixed ionic-electronic conductors. Although increasing channel thickness enhances transconductance, it also prolongs ion transport, resulting in the well-known gain-speed trade-off. Here, we demonstrate that engineering the internal morphology of PEDOT:PSS:PEI films through pH-induced aqueous phase separation provides an effective route to mitigate this limitation. The resulting interconnected pore network promotes electrolyte penetration and increases the electrochemically addressable volume, while DMSO treatment and annealing enhance the continuity and ordering of the PEDOT-rich electronic phase. Consequently, porous OECT channels achieve a transconductance of 30 mS and a response time of 13 ms at an ultralow gate voltage of 0.05 V despite channel thicknesses exceeding 100 um. Comparison of films with comparable electronic conductivity but different pore architectures identifies morphology as the dominant factor governing device performance, supporting a transition from predominantly surface-limited modulation toward spatially distributed mixed ionic-electronic transport. Beyond demonstrating a scalable water-based fabrication strategy, this work establishes internal morphology as a design parameter that complements molecular structure and device geometry in organic mixed conductors, providing a general framework for the development of high-performance OECTs, soft bioelectronics, and future neuromorphic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过pH诱导的PEDOT:PSS:PEI水相相分离工程化内部形貌，构建互连多孔网络，在超过100μm厚的OECT沟道中同时实现30 mS跨导和13 ms响应时间（栅压仅0.05 V），打破了传统的增益-速度权衡，并确立内部形貌作为与分子结构和器件几何并列的关键设计参数。
AI.motivation: OECT性能受离子可及性与电子传输之间的相互作用制约。增加沟道厚度虽可提升跨导，但会延长离子传输路径，导致众所周知的增益-速度权衡。作者希望找到一种途径来突破这一内在限制。
AI.method: 通过pH诱导PEDOT:PSS:PEI薄膜发生水相相分离，构建互连孔网络以促进电解质渗透并增大电化学可及体积；同时采用DMSO处理和退火增强PEDOT富集电子相的连续性和有序性。通过对比电子导率相近但孔结构不同的薄膜，系统研究形貌对器件性能的主导作用。
AI.result: 多孔OECT沟道在沟道厚度超过100μm、超低栅压0.05 V下实现了30 mS的跨导和13 ms的响应时间。对比实验表明形貌是决定器件性能的主导因素，器件行为从表面受限调制向空间分布的混合离子-电子传输转变。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了可扩展的水基制备策略，确立内部形貌作为与分子结构和器件几何互补的设计参数，为高性能OECT、柔性生物电子学和神经形态材料的发展提供了通用框架。

title: Type-II Mirror Chern Insulator in Altermagnets
summary: Altermagnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting despite zero net magnetization can support unique topological states under broken time-reversal symmetry. We predict a mirror-symmetry-protected topological crystalline insulator with momentum-separated edge modes in a two-dimensional altermagnet. Using a square-octagon lattice model, we show that altermagnetic order generates symmetry-related valley-polarized Dirac nodes, which are gapped by spin-orbit coupling to yield a mirror Chern insulator with $C_{\mathcal{M}}=2$. In contrast to conventional mirror Chern insulators, where the two mirror-protected edge modes cross at the same momentum to form a Dirac cone, altermagnetic spin splitting and valley-selective band inversion separate these edge modes in momentum. We refer to this phase as a type-II mirror Chern insulator. We further propose a PbSe/$\mathrm{V_2Se_2O}$ heterobilayer as a candidate material for realizing this phase through the altermagnetic proximity effect. Our results establish altermagnetism as a route to mirror-protected topological phases with momentum-separated edge modes.

AI.tldr: 本文预测了二维交替磁体（altermagnet）中一种由镜面对称保护的拓扑晶态绝缘体——II型镜面陈绝缘体。该相具有动量分离的边界态模式，与传统镜面陈绝缘体不同，其边界模式不在同一动量处交叉形成狄拉克锥。
AI.motivation: 探索交替磁体（具有动量相关自旋劈裂但净磁化为零）在时间反演对称破缺条件下支持独特拓扑态的可能性，特别是寻找不同于传统镜面陈绝缘体的新型拓扑相。
AI.method: 使用方八边形（square-octagon）晶格模型，证明交替磁序产生对称相关的谷极化狄拉克节点，自旋轨道耦合将其打开能隙，形成镜面陈数为C_M=2的镜面陈绝缘体。并提出PbSe/V2Se2O异质双层作为实现该相的材料候选。
AI.result: 预测并刻画了一种II型镜面陈绝缘体相，其中交替磁自旋劈裂和谷选择性能带反转将镜面保护的边界模式在动量上分离，这与传统镜面陈绝缘体中边界模式在同一动量交叉形成狄拉克锥的行为形成对比。
AI.conclusion: 交替磁性为在镜面保护下实现具有动量分离边界模式的拓扑相提供了新途径，拓展了拓扑材料的设计维度。

title: Fractional Spin Ferroelectric and Sliding Spin Current in Magnetic Sliding Ferroelectrics
summary: We investigate the fractional spin ferroelectric (FSFE) in magnetic sliding ferroelectrics (SFEs), where ferroelectric switching is characterized not only by the reversal of the out-of-plane electric polarization but also by a variation of fractional in-plane spin electronic polarization. We show that interlayer sliding in FSFEs can naturally lead to a symmetry-protected pure spin current, termed the sliding spin current here. The underlying mechanism is that, during switching, the contributions of valence electrons and ions to the in-plane charge transfer cancel each other, whereas the in-plane spin transfer, which stems solely from valence electrons, persists, leading to a pure spin current. We demonstrate our ideas in various material candidates, including $H$-stacked bilayer CrI$_3$, whose few-layer form has been experimentally confirmed to be a magnetic SFE, and $R$-stacked bilayers $2H$-V$X_2$ ($X=$ S, Se, Te), which have been experimentally synthesised. For a typical switching time of about $1$ ns, the estimated spin-current densities for bilayer CrI$_3$ and V$X_2$ reach $10^9 (\hbar/2e)\mathrm{A/m^2}$ and $10^8 (\hbar/2e)\mathrm{A/m^2}$, respectively. This means that by applying a periodic out-of-plane electric field, a significant alternating spin current can be generated in magnetic SFEs. Thus, our findings propose a compelling new mechanism for the all-electrical generation of pure spin current, and predict concrete realistic materials for experimental verification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了磁性滑移铁电体中的分数自旋铁电性，发现层间滑移可产生对称性保护的自旋纯电流（滑移自旋电流），并提出了全电学产生纯自旋电流的新机制，预测了CrI₃和VX₂等具体材料。
AI.motivation: 在磁性滑移铁电体中，铁电切换不仅涉及面外电极化反转，还伴随分数面内自旋电子极化的变化。作者希望探索这种滑移过程中能否产生纯自旋电流，从而为全电学产生自旋电流提供新途径。
AI.method: 作者识别出滑移铁电体中一个物理机制：切换过程中价电子和离子对面内电荷转移的贡献相互抵消，而仅由价电子贡献的面内自旋转移仍然存在，从而产生纯自旋电流。他们将该思想应用于H堆叠双层CrI₃和R堆叠2H-VX₂（X=S,Se,Te）等实验上已验证的材料体系中进行分析验证。
AI.result: 在典型约1 ns的切换时间内，双层CrI₃的自旋电流密度可达10⁹(ℏ/2e)A/m²，VX₂可达10⁸(ℏ/2e)A/m²。通过施加周期性面外电场，可以在磁性SFE中产生显著的交变自旋电流。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提出了一种引人注目的全电学产生纯自旋电流的新机制，并预测了可供实验验证的具体现实材料。

title: Surface Equilibration Mechanism Controls the Stability of a Model Co-deposited Glass Mixture of Organic Semiconductors
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 47 references, Supporting information including 5 figures
summary: While previous work has identified the conditions for preparing ultrastable single-component organic glasses by physical vapor deposition (PVD), little is known about the stability of co-deposited mixtures. Here, we prepared binary PVD glasses of organic semiconductors, TPD (N,N-Bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N-diphenylbenzidine) and m-MTDATA (4,4,4-Tris[phenyl(m-tolyl)amino]triphenylamine), with 50:50 mass concentration over a wide range of substrate temperatures (Tsub). The enthalpy and kinetic stability are evaluated with differential scanning calorimetry and spectroscopic ellipsometry. Binary organic semiconductor glasses with exceptional thermodynamic and kinetic stability comparable to the most stable single-component organic glasses are obtained when deposited at Tsub=0.78-0.90Tg (where Tg is the conventional glass transition temperature). When deposited at 0.94Tg, the enthalpy of m-MTDATA/TPD glass equals that expected for the equilibrium liquid at that temperature. Thus, the surface equilibration mechanism previously advanced for single-component PVD glasses is also applicable for these co-deposited glasses. These results provide an avenue for designing high-performance organic electronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过物理气相沉积（PVD）制备了TPD和m-MTDATA的二元有机半导体玻璃（50:50质量比），并系统研究了不同基底温度下的稳定性。发现当沉积温度在0.78-0.90Tg时，二元玻璃展现出与最稳定的单组分有机玻璃相当的热力学和动力学稳定性；在0.94Tg沉积时，其焓值甚至达到平衡液态水平。研究表明，此前提出的表面平衡机制同样适用于共沉积玻璃体系。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已明确单组分有机玻璃通过PVD制备超稳定玻璃的条件，但对共沉积（二元）混合物的稳定性知之甚少。理解二元共沉积玻璃的稳定性机制对于有机电子器件的设计与优化至关重要。
AI.method: 通过PVD制备TPD和m-MTDATA的二元玻璃（50:50质量比），在不同基底温度（Tsub）下沉积；利用差示扫描量热法（DSC）评估焓稳定性，利用光谱椭圆偏振法评估动力学（动力学）稳定性。
AI.result: 在Tsub=0.78-0.90Tg条件下沉积的二元有机半导体玻璃展现出与最稳定单组分玻璃相当的热力学和动力学稳定性；在0.94Tg下沉积时，m-MTDATA/TPD玻璃的焓值达到该温度下平衡液体所预期的水平。
AI.conclusion: 单组分PVD玻璃的表面平衡机制同样适用于二元共沉积玻璃，为通过PVD制备高性能有机电子器件提供了一条可行途径。

title: DynaCrys: Crystal Generation with Dynamic Space-Group Diffusion
summary: The search for new crystalline materials spans an enormous compositional and structural space. Generating candidates in this space requires jointly modeling discrete crystallographic symmetry, elemental composition, and continuous geometry. We introduce DynaCrys, a generative model for crystals in which the space group co-evolves with Wyckoff occupations and elements through a coupled symbolic diffusion process. The structured space-group transitions follow crystallographic group-subgroup relations. As the space group changes, a shared, pretrained symmetry codebook provides both the legality-constrained stochastic decoder and the symmetry-constrained crystal-geometry model with a common representation of the corresponding Wyckoff vocabulary. Across large-scale evaluations using two independent relaxation-and-evaluation engines, DynaCrys achieves best-in-class performance in symmetry-aware discovery of stable, unique, and novel crystals, both overall and under the additional requirement of nontrivial post-relaxation symmetry. It also enables fast sampling while generating structures with consistently low relaxation-induced structural displacements.

AI.tldr: DynaCrys是一个晶体生成模型，通过耦合符号扩散过程使空间群与Wyckoff占据和元素共同演化，利用晶体学群-子群关系实现结构化空间群转换，并借助共享的预训练对称性码本同时约束合法的随机解码器和对称性约束的晶体几何模型，在稳定、独特且新颖晶体的对称性感知发现中达到最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 新晶体材料搜索涉及巨大的成分和结构空间，需要同时建模离散的晶体学对称性、元素组成和连续几何结构，这是一个极具挑战性的联合建模问题。
AI.method: 提出耦合符号扩散过程，使空间群与Wyckoff占据和元素共同演化；空间群转换遵循晶体学群-子群关系；使用共享的预训练对称性码本，为约束合法的随机解码器和对称性约束的晶体几何模型提供统一的Wyckoff词汇表表示。
AI.result: 使用两个独立的弛豫与评估引擎进行大规模评估，DynaCrys在对称性感知的稳定、独特且新颖晶体发现任务中达到最佳性能，包括在要求非平凡弛豫后对称性的条件下；同时实现快速采样，并生成弛豫诱导结构位移一致较低的结构。
AI.conclusion: DynaCrys通过将离散对称性与连续几何在统一的生成框架中联合建模，显著提升了晶体材料发现的能力，兼顾了生成质量、速度和结构稳定性。
